G1468.ks: 자기를 다스리는 것을 뜻한다. 디도서 1:8에서 감독의 자격으로 '절제하며'로 나온다.

G1469.d: ἐγ-κρίνω, see: ἐνκ-. ἐν-κρίνω (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν), to reckon among : ἑαυτούς, 2Co.10:12.† (AS)
G1469.ks: 함께 헤아리다. 고린도후서 10:12에서 '감히 자기를 칭찬하는 자와 같이 헤아리다'에 쓰인다.

G1470.d: ἐγ-κρύπτω, [in LXX for טמן, etc. ;] to conceal in: with accusative, before εἰς, Mat.13:33.† (AS)
G1470.ks: 속에 감추다. 마태복음 13:33에서 여자가 가루 서 말 속에 누룩을 넣는 대목에 쓰인다.

G1471.d: ἔγκυος, see: ἐνκ-. ἔνκυoς (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν), -ον (κύω, to conceive), [in LXX: Sir.42:10 * ;] pregnant, big with child : Luk.2:5.† (AS)
G1471.ks: 아이를 밴 것을 뜻한다. 누가복음 2:5에서 마리아가 잉태하였다고 쓰인다.

G1472.d: ἐγχρίω, [in LXX: Jer.4:30 (קרע). Tob.2:10 6:8 11:7 * ;] to rub in, anoint: mid., with dupl. accusative, Rev.3:18.† (AS)
G1472.ks: 속에 문지르다, 바르다. 요한계시록 3:18에서 눈에 안약을 발라 보게 하라는 말씀에 쓰인다.

G1473.d: ἐγώ, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς, of person(s) pron. I. (a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in Mat.3:11, Mrk.1:8, Luk.3:16, al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as Mat.10:16, Jhn.10:17; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. 1Ki.3:8), Act.9:10; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, Jhn.1:23 (LXX), Act.7:32 (LXX). (b) The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, Jhn.14:20; μου τ. λόγους, Mat.7:24; ὀπίσω μου, Mat.3:11; ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, Rev.5:5; also with the prep. πρός, as Mrk.9:19, al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as Luk.10:16, Jhn.7:23, Mrk.14:7, al. (with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, Mat.2:6; μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, Mrk.9:24. (d) τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, Jdg.11:12, al.), i.e. what have we in common: Mat.8:29, Mrk.1:24, 5:7, Luk.8:28, Jhn.2:4; τί γάρ μοι, 1Co.5:2. (e) The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, Pr., 86f., M, Th., 131f.). (f) κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ), and I, even I, I also: Mat.2:8, Luk.2:48, Jhn.6:56, Rom.3:7, 1Co.7:40, al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, both . . . and, Jhn.7:28. (AS)
G1473.ks: 일인칭 대명사 '나'. 신약에서 '나는 ~이다'처럼 강조하여 쓰이며, 복수는 '우리'다.

G1474.d: ἐδαφίζω (ἔδαφος) [in LXX chiefly for רטשׁ pu. ;] 1. to beat level like a threshing floor (Theophr.). 2. to dash to the ground (Field, Notes, 74): Luk.19:44 (cf. Psa.136(137):9, Hos.14:1). † (AS)
G1474.ks: 땅바닥에 내던지다. 누가복음 19:44에서 예루살렘이 '땅에 엎어져' 파괴될 것을 말씀하시는 대목에 쓰인다.

G1475.d: ἔδαφος, -εος (-ους), τό, [in LXX for עָפָר, קַרְקע, etc. ;] bottom, pavement, ground: Act.22:7.† (AS)
G1475.ks: 땅바닥, 지면을 뜻한다. 사도행전 22:7에서 바울이 길에서 땅에 엎드러지는 장면에 쓰인다.

G1476.d: ἑδραῖος, -ον (ἕδρα, a seat), [in Sm.: Ps 32 (33):14, al. ;] 1. sitting, seated. 2. steadfast, firm; metaphorically, of moral fixity: 1Co.7:37 15:58, Col.1:23. † (AS)
G1476.ks: 굳센, 확고한 것을 뜻한다. 고린도전서 15:58의 '견고하며 흔들리지 말고'에 쓰인다.

G1477.ks: 받침, 지지물을 뜻한다. 디모데전서 3:15에서 교회를 '진리의 기둥과 터'라 하는 대목에 쓰인다.

G1478.d: Ἑζεκίας (Rec. Ἐζ-), -ου, ὁ (Heb. חִזְקִיָּה, strength of Jehovah), Hezekiah, King of Judah: Mat.1:9, 10.† (AS)
G1478.ks: 유다 왕, 예수의 족보에 나오는 사람 (마 1:9)

G1479.d: ἐθελο-θρησκία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ, self-imposed worship: Col.2:23 (eccl.; cf. DB, iv, 923a; Cremer, 733).† (AS)
G1479.ks: 스스로 정한 예배를 뜻한다. 골로새서 2:23에서 '자의적 숭배'로 한 번 쓰인다.

G1480.d: ἐθίζω, [in LXX: Sir.23:9, 13 2Ma.14:30 ;] to accustom: pass. pf. ptcp., τὸ εἰθισμένον, the established custom, Luk.2:27.† (AS)
G1480.ks: 길들이다, 습관이 되게 하다. 누가복음 2:27에서 부모가 율법의 관례대로 아기 예수를 데려간 대목에 쓰인다.

G1481.d: ἐθνάρχης, -ου, ὁ (ἔθνος, ἄρχω), [in LXX: 1Ma.14:47 15:1, 2 * ;] an ethnarch, a provincial governor (cf. I Mac, ll. with; FlJ, Ant., xiii, 6, 6; Dalman, 332): 2Co.11:32.† (AS)
G1481.ks: 한 민족을 다스리는 지방 통치자를 뜻한다. 고린도후서 11:32에서 아레다 왕의 방백으로 나온다.

G1482.d: ἐθνικός, -ή, -όν, [in Al.: Lev.21:7 * ;] 1. national (Polyb.). 2. foreign (gramm.); in NT, as subst., ὁ ἐ., the Gentile (the adj. "describes character rather than mere position"; cf. ἔθνος, and see Cremer, 228): Mat.5:47 6:7 18:17, 3Jo.7. † (AS)
G1482.ks: 민족의, 이방의 것을 뜻한다. 마태복음 5:47과 6:7에서 이방인을 가리키는 명사로 쓰인다.

G1483.ks: 이방인의 방식으로라는 뜻의 부사. 신약에서 갈라디아서 2장 14절에만 나온다.

G1484.d: ἔθνος, -ους, τό, [in LXX chiefly for עַם ,גּוֹי ;] 1. a multitude, a company, whether of beasts or men (Hom.). 2. a nation, people: Mat.21:43 24:7, Mrk.13:8, Luk.22:25, Act.10:35, al.; in sing., of the Jewish people, Luk.7:5 23:2, Jhn.11:48, 50-53 18:35, Act.10:22 24:3, 10 26:4 28:19. 3. In pl., as in OT, τὰ ἔ. (like Heb. הַגּוֹיִם), the nations, as distinct from Israel, Gentiles: Mat.4:15 6:32, Act.26:17, Rom.3:29 11:11 15:10, Gal.2:8, al.; of Gentile Christians, Rom.11:13 15:27 16:4, Gal.2:12, 14, Eph.3:1. SYN.: λαός (see DCG, ii, 229; Cremer, 226). (AS)
G1484.ks: 민족이나 백성을 뜻하며, 복수로는 이스라엘과 구별되는 이방 민족들을 가리킨다. 신약에서 유대 백성을 가리킬 때도 있다.

G1485.d: ἔθος, -εος (-ους), τό (ἔθω), [in LXX: Wis.14:16, Da TH Bel 15, 1Ma.10:89, 2Ma.11:25 13:4, 4Ma.18:5 א R* ;] habit, custom; Luk.22:39, Jhn.19:40, Act.16:21 25:16, Heb.10:25; in Luk.1:9 Act.6:14 15:1 21:21 26:3 28:17, almost in the narrower sense of law (Deiss., BS, 251 f.).† (AS)
G1485.ks: 습관이나 관례를 뜻한다. 신약에서 일상의 관습과 함께 율법에 가까운 의미로도 쓰인다.

G1486.d: ἔθω, pf. with present sense εἴωθα, [in LXX: Num.24:1 (כְּפַעַם־בְּפַעַם), Dan LXX Su 13, Sir.37:14, 4Ma.1:12 * ;] to be accustomed, wont: Mat.27:15, Mrk.10:1; ptcp., τὸ εἰθός, custom: κατὰ τὸ εἰ. (Nu, l.with), Luk.4:16, Act.17:2.† (AS)
G1486.ks: 습관이 되어 늘 하던 대로 하다라는 뜻의 동사. 완료형 εἴωθα가 현재의 뜻으로 쓰이며 누가복음 4장 16절 등에 나온다.

G1487G.d: εἰ, conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions. I. Conditional, if; 1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; (a) pres.: before indic, pres., Mat.11:14, Rom.8:25, al.; before imperat., Mrk.4:23 9:22, Jhn.15:18, 1Co.7:9, al.; before fut. indic., Luk.16:31, Rom.8:11, al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, Mat.12:26, Rom.4:14, al.; similarly, before impf., Luk.17:6, Jhn.8:39; before quæst., Mat.6:23, Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46, 1Pe.2:20; (b) fut.: Mat.26:33, 1Pe.2:20; (with) pf.: Jhn.11:12, Rom.6:5, al.; (d) aor.: Luk.16:11 19:8, Jhn.13:32, 18:23, Rev.20:15, al. 2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: Mat.12:28, Jhn.7:4, Rom.5:17, al. 3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i). 4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: Mrk.15:44, 1Jn.3:13, al. 5. C. indic., as in LXX (Num.14:3o, 1Ki.14:45, al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): Mrk.8:12, Heb.3:11" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX). 6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: Act.24:19 27:39, 1Co.14:10 15:37, I Pe3:14, 17. II. Interrogative, if, whether. 1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Mat.26:63, Mrk.15:36, Act.19:2, 2Co.13:5, al.; fut., Mrk.3:2, Act.8:22, al.; aor., Mrk.15:44, 1Co.1:16, al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), Php.3:12. 2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, Gen.17:17, al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: Mrk.8:23 (Tr., WH, txt.), Luk.13:23, 22:49, Act.19:2, al. III. With…

As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Mat.26:63, Mrk.15:36, Act.19:2, 2Co.13:5, al.; fut., Mrk.3:2, Act.8:22, al.; aor., Mrk.15:44, 1Co.1:16, al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), Php.3:12. 2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, Gen.17:17, al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: Mrk.8:23 (Tr., WH, txt.), Luk.13:23, 22:49, Act.19:2, al. III. With…
G1487M.ks: 접속사 εἰ가 양보의 뜻으로 '비록 ~일지라도'를 나타내는 용법.

G1491.d: εἶδος, -ους, τό, [in LXX for מַרְאֶה,, etc. ;] 1. that which is seen, appearance, external form: Luk.3:22 9:29, Jhn.5:37, 2Co.5:7 (ICC in l.). 2. form, sort, kind: 1Th.5:22. † (AS)
G1491.ks: 눈에 보이는 것, 곧 외형이나 모양을 뜻한다. 또한 종류나 형태의 뜻으로도 쓰인다.

G1492G.d: οἶδα, (from same root as εἶδον, which see), [in LXX chiefly for ידע ;] pf. with present meaning (plpf. as impf.; on irregular tense-forms, see App.), to have seen or perceived, hence, to know, have knowledge of: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.25:13, Mrk.10:19, Jhn.10:4, Rom.7:7, al.; with accusative of person(s), Mat.26:72, Jhn.1:31, Act.3:16, al.; τ. θεόν, 1Th.4:5, Tit.1:16, al.; with accusative and inf., Luk.4:41, al.; before ὅτι, Mat.9:6, Luk.20:21, Jhn.3:2, Rom.2:2 11:2, al.; before quaest. indir., Mat.26:70, Jhn.9:21, Eph.1:18, al.; with inf., to know how (cl.), Mat.7:11, Luk.11:13, Php.4:12, 1Th.4:4, al.; in unique sense of respect, appreciate: 1Th.5:12 (but see also ICC on 1Th.4:4). SYN.: see: γινώσκω. (AS)
G1492G.ks: 보아서 알게 되었다는 데서 '알다'를 뜻한다. 완료형이 현재의 뜻으로 쓰이며 사물과 사람을 목적어로 취한다.

G1492H.d: οἶδα, (from same root as εἶδον, which see), [in LXX chiefly for ידע ;] pf. with present meaning (plpf. as impf.; on irregular tense-forms, see App.), to have seen or perceived, hence, to know, have knowledge of: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.25:13, Mrk.10:19, Jhn.10:4, Rom.7:7, al.; with accusative of person(s), Mat.26:72, Jhn.1:31, Act.3:16, al.; τ. θεόν, 1Th.4:5, Tit.1:16, al.; with accusative and inf., Luk.4:41, al.; before ὅτι, Mat.9:6, Luk.20:21, Jhn.3:2, Rom.2:2 11:2, al.; before quaest. indir., Mat.26:70, Jhn.9:21, Eph.1:18, al.; with inf., to know how (cl.), Mat.7:11, Luk.11:13, Php.4:12, 1Th.4:4, al.; in unique sense of respect, appreciate: 1Th.5:12 (but see also ICC on 1Th.4:4). SYN.: see: γινώσκω. (AS)
G1492H.ks: 보아서 알게 되었다는 뜻의 동사 οἶδα의 용법 중 '보다'의 의미.

G1492I.d: οἶδα, (from same root as εἶδον, which see), [in LXX chiefly for ידע ;] pf. with present meaning (plpf. as impf.; on irregular tense-forms, see App.), to have seen or perceived, hence, to know, have knowledge of: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.25:13, Mrk.10:19, Jhn.10:4, Rom.7:7, al.; with accusative of person(s), Mat.26:72, Jhn.1:31, Act.3:16, al.; τ. θεόν, 1Th.4:5, Tit.1:16, al.; with accusative and inf., Luk.4:41, al.; before ὅτι, Mat.9:6, Luk.20:21, Jhn.3:2, Rom.2:2 11:2, al.; before quaest. indir., Mat.26:70, Jhn.9:21, Eph.1:18, al.; with inf., to know how (cl.), Mat.7:11, Luk.11:13, Php.4:12, 1Th.4:4, al.; in unique sense of respect, appreciate: 1Th.5:12 (but see also ICC on 1Th.4:4). SYN.: see: γινώσκω. (AS)
G1492I.ks: 보아서 알게 되었다는 뜻의 동사 οἶδα의 용법 중 '알다, 지식이 있다'의 의미.

G1493.d: εἰδώλον (Rec. -εῖον), -ου, τό (εἴδωλον), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:2 (בֵּית אוֹצַר אֱלֹהִים), Bel 9, I Est.2:10, 1Ma.1:47 10:83 * ;] an idol's temple: 1Co.8:10 (cf. Ἀσταρτεῖον, 1Ki.31:10; see ICC, in I Co, l.with).† (AS)
G1493.ks: 우상을 모신 신당을 뜻한다. 신약에서 고린도전서 8장 10절에만 나온다.

G1494.d: εἰδωλόθυτος, -ον, (εἴδωλον, θύω), [in LXX: 4Ma.5:2 * ;] sacrificed to idols: τὸ, τὰ εἰ, Act.15:29 21:25, 1Co.8:1, 4 7, 10 10:19, Rev.2:14, 2o.† (AS)
G1494.ks: 우상에게 바쳐진 제물을 뜻하며, 주로 중성으로 '우상의 제물'이라 쓰인다. 사도행전과 고린도전서, 요한계시록에 나온다.

G1495.d: εἰδωλο-λατρία (-εία, Rec.), -ας, ἡ (εἴδωλον, λατρεία), idolatry: 1Co.10:14, Gal.5:20, Col.3:5; pl. (Bl, §32, 6), 1Pe.4:3 (Cremer, 390).† (AS)
G1495.ks: 우상을 섬기는 일을 뜻한다. 고린도전서, 갈라디아서, 골로새서, 베드로전서에 나온다.

G1496.d: εἰδωλολάτρης, -ου, ὁ (εἴδωλου + λάτρις, a hireling), an idolator: 1Co.5:10, 11 6:9 10:7 Eph.5:5 Rev.21:8 22:15 (Cremer, 709).† (AS)
G1496.ks: 우상을 섬기는 사람을 뜻한다. 죄인의 목록에 자주 나오며 고린도전서, 에베소서, 요한계시록에 쓰인다.

G1497.d: εἴδωλον, -ου, τό (εἶδος), [in LXX for אֱלוֹהָּ, גְּלוּלִים, etc. ;] 1. in cl. (a) a phantom, image, likeness; (b) an image in the mind, an idea, fancy. 2. In LXX and NT, (a) an image of a god, an idol (cf. Polyb., xxxi, 3, 13): Act.7:41, 1Co.12:2, Rev.9:20; (b) the false god or idol worshipped in an image (ICC, on I Th, l.with): Act.15:20, Rom.2:22, 1Co.8:4, 7 10:19 2Co.6:18, 1Th.1:9, 1Jn.5:21.† (AS)
G1497.ks: 신의 형상, 또는 형상으로 섬기는 거짓 신을 가리킨다. 헬라어 일반에서는 환영이나 모양의 뜻도 있다.

G1500.d: εἰκῇ (-ῆ, Rec., as in cl.), adv., [in LXX: Pro.28:25 (εἰκῇ)* ;] 1. without cause or reason: Mat.5:22 (E, mg.), Col.2:18 (ICC). 2. vainly, fruitlessly, to no purpose: Rom.13:4, 1Co.15:2, Gal.3:4 4:11, Col.2:18. † (AS)
G1500.ks: 이유 없이, 또는 헛되게라는 뜻의 부사. 로마서 13장 4절과 고린도전서 15장 2절 등에 쓰인다.

G1501.d: εἴκοσι (never -ιν in WH, cf. Bl., §5, 3, and note), indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά, twenty: Luk.14:31, Jhn.6:19, Act.1:15 27:28, 1Co.10:8, Rev.4:4, 10 5:8 11:16 19:4.† (AS)
G1501.ks: 숫자 20을 뜻하는 불변화 수사. 신약에서 여러 곳에 쓰인다.

G1502.ks: 물러서서 양보하다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 갈라디아서 2장 5절에만 나온다.

G1503.d: εἴκω (obsolete pres.), see: ἔοικα Transcriber note: This form does not occur in Abbott-Smith. It should be on p. 158.. (AS)
G1503.ks: εἴκω의 다른 형태로, ἔοικα(닮다)를 참조하라고 되어 있다. 사전 원문에 설명이 거의 없다.

G1504.d: εἰκών, -όνος (cf. ἔοικα), [in LXX chiefly for צֶלֶם ;] an image, likeness: Mat.22:20, Mrk.12:16, Luk.20:24, Rom.1:23, 1Co.15:49, Rev.13:14, 15 14:9, 11 15:2 16:2 19:20 20:4; opposite to σκιά, Heb.10:1; of man, εἰ. θεοῦ, 1 Co 11:7; of the regenerate, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ Col.3:10 (see Lft., in l.); εἰ. τ. υἱοῦ τ. θεοῦ, Rom.8:29, 2Co.3:18; of Christ, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ, 2Co.4:4, Col.1:15.† SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, denoting resemblance, which may however be merely accidental. εἰ. is a derived likeness and like the head on a coin or the parental likeness in a child, implies an archetype. Cf. also εἶδος, appearance, not necessarily based on reality; σκιά, a shadowed resemblance; χαρακτήρ, the impress of a stamp; μόρφη (which see), the form as indicative of the inner being. (AS)
G1504.ks: 형상이나 닮은 모습을 뜻한다. 사람을 하나님의 형상으로, 그리스도를 하나님의 형상으로 말할 때 쓰인다.

G1505.d: εἰλικρινία (Rec., cl., -κρινεία), -ας, ἡ (εἰλικρινής), [in LXX: Wis.7:25 A * ;] sincerity, purity: 1Co.5:8, 2Co.1:12 2:17.† (AS)
G1505.ks: 섞임 없이 순수함, 곧 진실함을 뜻한다. 고린도전서 5장 8절과 고린도후서에 나온다.

G1506.d: εἰλικρινής, -ές, [in LXX: Wi 72^ kB * ;] unalloyed, pure (Lat. sincerus; see DCG, ii, 635a); (a) of unmixed substances; (b) of abstract ideas; (with) of ethical purity: Php.1:10, 2Pe.3:1.† SYN.: ἁγνός (which see), καθαρός, cf. Tr., Syn.: §lxxxv; DB, iv, 176a; Cremer, 378; Westc. on 1Jn.3:3. (AS)
G1506.ks: 섞인 것이 없이 순수하다는 뜻의 형용사. 윤리적 순결을 나타내며 빌립보서 1장 10절 등에 나온다.

G1510.d: εἰμί, with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be. I. As substantive verb. 1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28. 2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24:3, Mrk.14:2, 15:42, Luk.21:23, Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10, al. 3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mat.2:13, 15, Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Luk.1:80, 5:29, Jhn.7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mrk.2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mat.1:20, 21:25, Mrk.11:30, Jhn.3:31, al. 4. Impers., ἔστι, ἦν, etc.; (a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: Mat.16:28, Luk.16:19, Jhn.3:1, 5:2, Rom.3:10, al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), Mat.16:22, Luk.1:7, Jhn.18.10, Rom.9:2, al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), Mat.16:28, 19:2, Mrk.9:1, al.; (b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: Heb.9:5, 1Co.11:20, RV (but see ICC, in l.). II. As copula uniting subject and predicate. 1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: Mat.5:13, 14:15, Luk.1:18, 19, Jhn.1:1, 4:19, Rev.3:9, al. mult. 2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: Mat.13:19, 1Co.9:2, 10:4, 11:25, Gal.4:24, Rev.17:15, al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, Mat.27:46, Mrk.7:2, Rom.7:18 al.; ὅ ἐστιν, Mrk.3:17, Col.1:24, Heb.7:2, al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: Mat.26:26-28, Mrk.14:22, 24, Luk.22:19, 1Co.11:24 (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.). 3. C. genitive: qual., etc., Mrk.5:42, Luk.3:23, 1Co.14:33, Heb.12:11, al.; part., 1Ti.1:20, 2Ti.1:15; poss., Mat.5:3, 10, Mrk.12:7, Luk.4:7; of service or partisanship, Rom.8:9, 1Co.1:12, 2Co.10:…
G1510.ks: 영어의 be동사처럼 여러 뜻으로 쓰이는 동사. 존재하다, 일어나다, 연결하는 말로 쓰인다.

G1511.d: εἰμί, with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be. I. As substantive verb. 1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28. 2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24:3, Mrk.14:2, 15:42, Luk.21:23, Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10, al. 3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mat.2:13, 15, Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Luk.1:80, 5:29, Jhn.7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mrk.2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mat.1:20, 21:25, Mrk.11:30, Jhn.3:31, al. 4. Impers., ἔστι, ἦν, etc.; (a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: Mat.16:28, Luk.16:19, Jhn.3:1, 5:2, Rom.3:10, al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), Mat.16:22, Luk.1:7, Jhn.18.10, Rom.9:2, al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), Mat.16:28, 19:2, Mrk.9:1, al.; (b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: Heb.9:5, 1Co.11:20, RV (but see ICC, in l.). II. As copula uniting subject and predicate. 1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: Mat.5:13, 14:15, Luk.1:18, 19, Jhn.1:1, 4:19, Rev.3:9, al. mult. 2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: Mat.13:19, 1Co.9:2, 10:4, 11:25, Gal.4:24, Rev.17:15, al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, Mat.27:46, Mrk.7:2, Rom.7:18 al.; ὅ ἐστιν, Mrk.3:17, Col.1:24, Heb.7:2, al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: Mat.26:26-28, Mrk.14:22, 24, Luk.22:19, 1Co.11:24 (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.). 3. C. genitive: qual., etc., Mrk.5:42, Luk.3:23, 1Co.14:33, Heb.12:11, al.; part., 1Ti.1:20, 2Ti.1:15; poss., Mat.5:3, 10, Mrk.12:7, Luk.4:7; of service or partisanship, Rom.8:9, 1Co.1:12, 2Co.10:…

G1514.d: εἰρηνεύω (εἰρήνη), [in LXX chiefly for שׁלם, שׁקט ;] 1. to bring to peace, reconcile (so 1Ma.6:60). 2. to keep peace, be at peace: Mrk.9:50, Rom.12:18, 2Co.13:11, 1Th.5:13 (cf. Sir.28:9; Cremer, 246). † (AS)
G1514.ks: 평화를 이루거나 화목하게 지내다라는 뜻의 동사. 마가복음 9장 50절과 로마서 12장 18절 등에 나온다.

G1515.d: εἰρήνη, -ης, ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלוֹם ;] peace; 1. of public peace, freedom from war: Luk.14:32, Act.12:20 24:2; of the church, Ac 9:31. 2. Of peace between persons, concord, agreement : Mat.10:34, Luk.12:51, Rom.14:17, 1Co.7:15, Gal.5:22, Jas.3:18; ζητεῖν εἰ., 1Pe.3:11; διώκειν, 2Ti.2:22; ib. before μετὰ πάντων, Heb.12:14; by meton., of him who brings peace, Eph.2:14. 3. As in LXX (= Heb. שָׁלוֹם, Aram. שְׁלָם), of a state of security and safety: Jhn.16:33, Rom.2:10, 1Th.5:3,́ whence the formulae, ὕπαγε (πορεύου) εἰς εἰ, Mrk.5:34, Luk.7:50 (cf. 1Ki.1:17, al.; לְכִי לְשָׁלוֹם); εἰ. ὑμῖν (שָׁלוֹם לָכֶם), Jhn.20:19, 21, 26; ἀπολύειν ἐν εἰ., Luk.2:29, cf. 1Co.16:11; ἡ εἰ. ὑμῶν, Mat.10:13, Luk.10:6; υἱὸς εἰρήνης, ib. 4. Of spiritual peace, the peace of Christ's kingdom (DCG, ii, 330f.): Luk.1:79 2:14 Jhn.16:33, Rom.2:10 5:1 8:6, al.; ὁ κύριος τῆς εἰ., 2Th.3:16; ὁ θεὸς τῆς εἰ., Rom.15:33 16:20, 2Co.13:11, al.; in epistolary salutations, Rom.1:7, 1Co.1:3, Gal.1:3, 1Th.1:1, 1Pe.1:2, 2Jo.3, Rev.1:4, al. (see Cremer, 244). (AS)
G1515.ks: 전쟁이 없는 평화와 사람 사이의 화목을 뜻한다. 구약 שָׁלוֹם(샬롬)에 해당하는 대표적인 단어이다.

G1516.d: είρηνικός, -ή, -όν (εἰρήνη), [in LXX for שָׁלוֹם and cognates ;] peaceful: Heb.12:11, Jas.3:17.† (AS)
G1516.ks: 평화로운 성질을 가리키는 형용사. 히브리서 12장 11절과 야고보서 3장 17절에 나온다.

G1517.ks: 평화를 만들다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 골로새서 1장 20절에만 나온다.

G1518.ks: 평화를 이루는 사람을 뜻한다. 마태복음 5장 9절에만 나온다.

G1519.d: εἰς, prep. with accusative, expressing entrance, direction, limit, into, unto, to, upon, towards, for, among (Lat. in, with accusative). I. Of place. 1. After verbs of motion; (a) of entrance into: Mat.8:23, 9:7, Mrk.1:45, Luk.2:15, 8:31, al.; (b) of approach, to or towards: Mrk.11:1, Luk.6:8, 19:28, Jhn.11:31, 21:6, al.; (with) before pl. and collective nouns, among: Mrk.4:7, 8:19, 20, Luk.11:49, Jhn.21:23, al.; (d) Of a limit reached, unto, on, upon: Mat.8:18, 21:1, Mrk.11:1, 13:16, Luk.14:10, Jhn.6:3, 11:32, al.; with accusative of person(s) (as in Ep. and Ion.), Act.23:15, Rom.5:12, 16:19, 2Co.10:14; (e) elliptical: ἐπιστολαὶ εἰς Δαμασκόν, Act.9:2; ἡ διακονία μου ἡ εἰς Ἱ., Rom.15:31; metaphorically, of entrance into a certain state or condition, or of approach or direction towards some end (Thayer, B, i, 1; ii, 1), εἰς τ. ὄνομα, M, Pr., 200. 2. Of direction; (a) after verbs of seeing: Mat.6:26, Mrk.6:41, Luk.9:16, 62, Jhn.13:22, al.; metaphorically, of the mind, Heb.11:26, 12:2, al.; (b) after verbs of speaking: Mat.13:10, 14:9, 1Th.2:9, al. 3. After verbs of rest; (a) in "pregnant" construction, implying previous motion (cl.; see WM, 516; Bl., §39, 3; M, Pr., 234f.): Mat.2:23, 4:13, 2Th.2:4, 2Ti.1:11, Heb.11:9, al.; (b) by an assimilation general in late Gk (see Bl., M, Pr., ll. with) = ἐν: Luk.1:44, 4:23, Act.20:16, 21:17, Jhn.1:18 (but see Westc, in l.), al. II. Of time, for, unto; 1. accentuating the duration expressed by the accusative: εἰς τ. αἰῶνα, Mat.21:19; εἰς γενεὰς καὶ γ., Luk.1:50; εἰς τ. διηνεκές, Heb.7:3, al. 2. Of a point or limit of time, unto, up to, until: Mat.6:34, Act.4:3, 25:21, Php.1:10, 2:16, 1Th.…
G1519.ks: 목적격과 함께 쓰여 장소·방향·목적 등을 나타내는 전치사.

G1520.d: εἷς ιά, ἕν, genitive ἑνός, μιᾶς, ἑνός, cardinal numeral, one; 1. one, as opposite to many: Mat.25:15, Rom.5:12, 1Co.10:8, al.; as subst., Rom.5:15, Eph.2:14; id. with genitive partit., Mat.5:19, al.; before ἐκ (ἐξ), Mrk.14:18, Jhn.6:8, al.; metaphorically, of union and concord, Jhn.10:30 17:11, Rom.12:4-5, Php.1:27; ἀπὸ μιᾶς (B1., § 44, 1), Luk.14:18; with neg., εἷς. . . οὐ (μή), more emphatic than οὐδείς, no one, none (cl.), Mat.5:18 10:29, Luk.11:46 12:6. 2. Emphatically, to the exclusion of others; (a) a single (one): Mat.21:24, Mrk.8:14; absol., 1Co.9:24, al.; οὐδὲ εἷς, Mat.27:14, Jhn.1:3, Rom.3:10, al.; (b) one, alone: Mrk.2:7 10:18, Luk.18:19; (with) one and the same: Rom.3:30, 1Co.3:8 11:5 12:11, 1Jn.5:8. 3. In late Gk., with weakened force, = τις or indef. art. (of. Heb. אֶחָד, Gen.22:13, al.; see B1., § 45, 2; M, Pr., 96 f.): Mat.8:19 19:6, Rev.8:13, al.; εἷς τις (Bl., l.with), Luk.22:50, Jhn.11:49 4. Distributively: εἷς καστος (cl.), Luk.4:40, Act.2:6, al.; εἷς . . . καὶ εἷς (cl., εἷς μὲν . . . εἷς δέ), Mat.17:4, Mrk.9:5, Jhn.20:12, al. (cf. LXX and use of Heb. אֶחָד, Exo.17:12, al); ὁ εἷς . . . ὁ ἕτερος (ἄλλος) = cl. ὁ μὲν (ἕτερος) . . . ὁ δέ (ἕτερος), Mat.6:24, Luk.7:41, Rev.17:10; καθ᾽ εἷς, εἷς κ. είς (in which καθ᾽ is adverbial, or the expression formed from the analogy of ἕν καθ᾽ ἔν; M, Pr., 105), one by one, severally: Mrk.14:19, Rom.12:5, al.; εἷς τὸν ἕνα = ἀλλήλους (B1., 45, 2; M, Pr., 246), 1Th.5:11. 5. As ordinal = πρῶτος (like Heb. אֶחָד; Bl., § 45, 1; M, Pr., 95 f.), first: Mat.28:1, Mrk.16:2, al (AS)
G1520.ks: 기본 수사 '하나'를 뜻한다. 여럿과 대비되거나 연합과 일치를 나타낼 때도 쓰인다.

G1521.d: εἰσ-άγω [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא, hi. ;] to bring in: with accusative, Luk.2:27, Jhn.18:16, Act.7:45; before εἰς, Luk.22:54, Act.9:8 21:28-29, 37 22:24, Heb.1:6; ὧδε, Luk.14:21.† (AS)
G1521.ks: 안으로 데리고 들어가다라는 뜻의 동사. 누가복음 2장 27절과 사도행전 등에 나온다.

G1522.d: είσ-ακούω [in LXX chiefly for שָׁמַע, also for עָנָה, etc. ;] to listen to, in two senses; (a) to obey: 1Co.14:21 (cf. Deu.1:43, Sir.3:6) (b) to listen, assent to; pass., to be heard: of persons praying, Mat.6:7, Heb.5:7; of the prayer offered, Luk.1:13, Act.10:31 (cf. Psa.4:2, Sir.34:26); see Cremer, 624).† (AS)
G1522.ks: 듣고 순종하다, 또는 기도가 들려지다라는 뜻의 동사. 마태복음 6장 7절과 히브리서 5장 7절에 나온다.

G1523.ks: 영접하여 받아들이다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 고린도후서 6장 17절에만 나온다.

G1524.d: εἴσ-ειμι [in LXX for בּוֹא ;] to go in, enter: before εἰς, Act.3:3 21:26, Heb.9:6; πρὸς Ἰάκωβον, Act.21:18.† (AS)
G1524.ks: 안으로 들어가다라는 뜻의 동사. 사도행전 3장 3절과 히브리서 9장 6절 등에 나온다.

G1525.d: εἰσ-έρχομαι, [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;] to go in or into, enter: Mat.9:25, Luk.7:45, al.; before εἰς, Mat.10:12, Mrk.2:1, al.; before διά (πύλης, θύρας, etc.), Mat.7:13, Jhn.10:1, al.; ὑπὸ τ. στέγην, Mat.8:8; with adv.: ὅπου, Mrk.14:14, Heb.6:20; ὧδε, Mat.22:12; ἔσω, Mat.26:58; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Mrk.15:43, Luk.1:28, Act.10:3 11:3 16:40 17:2 28:8, Rev.3:20; of demons taking possession, Mrk.9:25, Luk.8:30 22:3, Jhn.13:27; of food, Mat.15:11, Act.11:8. Metaphorical, of thoughts, Luk.9:46; εἰς κόπον, Jhn.4:38; εἰς πειρασμόν, Mat.26:41, Luk.22:40, 46; of hope as an anchor, Heb.6:19; βοαί, Jas.5:4; πνεῦμα ζωῆς, Rev.11:11; εἰς τ. κόσμον (cf. Wis.2:24 14:14, Jhn.18:37), Rom.5:12, Heb.10:5; in counterparts of Jewish Aram. phrases relating to the theocracy (cf. Dalman, Words, 116ff.): εἰς τ. γάμους, Mat.25:10; εἰς τ. χάραν τ. κυρίου, Mat.25:21, 23; εἰς τ. ζωήν, Mat.18:8, 9 19:17, Mrk.9:43, 45; εἰς τ. βασιλ. τ. οὐρανῶν, Mat.5:20 7:21, al. (see: βασιλεία); εἰς τ. κατάπαυσιν, Heb.3:11, 18 4:1ff.; εἰς τ. δόξαν, Luk.24:26; εἰσ. καὶ ἐξερχ., to go in and out (like Heb. בוֹא וְצֵאת, Deu.28:6, etc.), of familiar intercourse, Act.1:21; figuratively, of moral freedom, Jhn.10:9 (cf. ἐπ-, παρ-, συν-εισέρχομαι). (AS)
G1525.ks: 안으로 들어가다라는 뜻의 동사. 집, 성, 나라 등에 들어가거나 하나님 나라에 들어간다고 할 때 쓰인다.

G1528.d: εἰσ-καλέω, -ῶ, to call in: mid., with accusative of person(s), Act.10:23.† (AS)
G1528.ks: 사람을 안으로 불러들이다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 사도행전 10장 23절에만 나온다.

G1529.d: εἴσ-οδος, -ου, ὁ (ὁδός) [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;] 1. a means of entering, place of entrance: Heb.10:19, 2Pe.1:11 (cf. Westc., He., l.with; MM, Exp., xii; but see infr.). 2. a going in, entrance: Act.13:24; with genitive loc., Heb.10:19 (Thayer, see word; but see supr.); before εἰς, 2Pe.1:11 (Mayor, in l.; Thayer; but see supr.); πρός, 2Th.1:9 2:1.† (AS)
G1529.ks: 들어가는 일이나 들어가는 통로를 뜻한다. 히브리서 10장 19절과 베드로후서 1장 11절에 나온다.

G1530.d: εἰσ-πηδάω, -ῶ [in LXX: Amo.5:19 (בּוֹא), Da TH Sus 1:26* ;] to spring in, rush in: Act.14:14 (Rec.), Act.16:29 (for exx. from π., see MM, Exp., xii).† (AS)
G1530.ks: 안으로 뛰어들어가다라는 뜻의 동사. 사도행전 14장 14절과 16장 29절에 나온다.

G1531.d: εἰσ-πορεύομαι [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;] to go into, enter: Luk.8:16 11:33 19:30; before εἰς, Mrk.1:21 6:56 11:2, Luk.22:10, Act.3:2; πρός, with accusative of person(s), Act.28:30; ὅπου, Mrk.5:40; κατά τ. οἴκους, house after house, Act.8:3; of things (food), Mat.15:17, Mrk.7:15, 18-19 Metaphorical (cf. εἰοέρχομαι, 2), Mrk.4:19, Luk.18:24; εἰσ. καὶ ἐκπορ., to associate with, before μετά (cf. εἰσέρχομαι), Act.9:28.† (AS)
G1531.ks: 안으로 들어가다라는 뜻의 동사. 사람의 들어감뿐 아니라 음식이 입으로 들어가는 것에도 쓰인다.

G1532.ks: 안으로 달려 들어가다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 사도행전 12장 14절에만 나온다.

G1533.d: εἰσ-φέρω [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא hi. ;] to bring in, into: with accusative of person(s), Luk.5:18-19; before εἰς, Mat.6:13, Luk.11:4; ἐπί, Luk.12:11; with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς, 1Ti.6:7; pass., Heb.13:11.† (AS)
G1533.ks: 안으로 가져가거나 데려가다라는 뜻의 동사. 마태복음 6장 13절의 '시험에 들게 하다'에도 쓰인다.

G1534.d: εἶτα adv., denoting sequence; 1. of time; then, next: Mrk.8:25, Luk.8:12, Jhn.13:5 19:27 20:27, 1Ti.3:10, Jas.1:15; before genitive abs., Mrk.4:17; in enumerations, 1Co.15:5 15:7 15:24, 1Ti.2:13. 2. In argument; (a) therefore, then, (b) furthermore: Heb.12:9 (cf. εἶτεν).† (AS)
G1534.ks: 순서상 '그 다음에, 그리고 나서'를 뜻하는 부사. 시간의 순서나 논증의 전개에 쓰인다.

G1535.d: εἴτε, see: εἰ. εἰ, conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions. I. Conditional, if; 1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; (a) pres.: before indic, pres., Mat.11:14, Rom.8:25, al.; before imperat., Mrk.4:23 9:22, Jhn.15:18, 1Co.7:9, al.; before fut. indic., Luk.16:31, Rom.8:11, al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, Mat.12:26, Rom.4:14, al.; similarly, before impf., Luk.17:6, Jhn.8:39; before quæst., Mat.6:23, Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46, 1Pe.2:20; (b) fut.: Mat.26:33, 1Pe.2:20; (with) pf.: Jhn.11:12, Rom.6:5, al.; (d) aor.: Luk.16:11 19:8, Jhn.13:32, 18:23, Rev.20:15, al. 2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: Mat.12:28, Jhn.7:4, Rom.5:17, al. 3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i). 4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: Mrk.15:44, 1Jn.3:13, al. 5. C. indic., as in LXX (Num.14:3o, 1Ki.14:45, al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): Mrk.8:12, Heb.3:11" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX). 6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: Act.24:19 27:39, 1Co.14:10 15:37, I Pe3:14, 17. II. Interrogative, if, whether. 1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Mat.26:63, Mrk.15:36, Act.19:2, 2Co.13:5, al.; fut., Mrk.3:2, Act.8:22, al.; aor., Mrk.15:44, 1Co.1:16, al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), Php.3:12. 2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, Gen.17:17, al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: Mrk.8:23 (Tr., WH, txt.), Luk.13:23, 22:49, A…
G1535.ks: εἰ에서 나온 접속사로 '~이든지 ~이든지'를 뜻한다. 조건과 간접 의문에 쓰인다.

G1537.d: ἐκ (ἐξ), prep. with genitive, from out of, from (see Addendum, p. 492). This entry is included here, but in the print version the entry is found on p. 492. ἐκ, before a vowel ἐξ, prep. with genitive, of motion outwards, separation from (opposite to εἰς; = Lat. e, ex), from out of, from among, from. I. Of Place, 1. of motion, out of, forth from, off from: Jhn.6:31, Act.9:3, Gal.1:8, al.; esp. after verbs of motion, Mat.8:28 17:9, Mrk.1:25 7:28, Jhn.1:33 20:1, Act.12:7, 17 27:30, al.; constr. praeg., σώζειν (διας) ἐκ, Ju 5, Act.28:4. Metaphorical, Mat.7:4, 5, 1Pe.2:9; ἐκ τ. χειρός (-ῶν), before genitive of person(s), Luk.1:74, Jhn.10:28, 29, 39, Act.12:4 24:7, Rev.19:2; πίνειν (which see) ἐκ; of the place from which an action proceeds, Luk.5:3 (cf. 12:36, Jhn.13:4, 2Co.2:4). 2. Of change from one place or condition to another: Jhn.8:42, Rom.6:13 13:11, Rev.7:14, al.; with ellips. of verb of motion, 2Ti.2:26, 2Pe.2:21, Rev.2:21, al. 3. Of separation or distinction from a number, before collective or pl. nouns: Mat.13:47, 49, Jhn.12:1, Act.3:15, 1Pe.1:3, al.; after εἷς, Mat.10:29 Luk.17:15, al.; οὐδείς, Jhn.7:19, al.; πολλοί, Jhn.11:19, al.; τις, Luk.11:15, al.; τίς, Mat.6:27, al.; in partitive phrase as subject of sentence, Jhn.16:17; Hebraistically, ἐκ μέσου before genitive, = ἐκ (Heb. מִתּוֹךְ), Mat.13:49, al. 4. Of position or direction (so in cl. = ἔξω): ἐκ δεξιῶν (see: δεξιός); ἐξ ἐναντίας, Mrk.15:39 (metaphorically, Tit.2:8); ἐκ ῥιζῶν (i.e., utterly), Mat.11:20. II. Of Time, 1. of the point of time from which, from, since: ἐκ γενετῆς, Jhn.9:1, cf. Mrk.10:20, Luk.23:8, Act.24:10, al. 2. Of succession in time: ἐκ δευτέρου, a second time, Mrk.14:72, al.,…
G1537.ks: 속격과 함께 쓰여 밖으로 나가는 움직임과 출처를 나타내는 전치사. εἰς의 반대말이다.

G1538.d: 1. every, every one, each, each one , Lat. quisque, (Homer), etc.; the singular is often joined with a pl. Verb, ἔβαν οἴκονδε ἕκαστος they went home every one of them , (Iliad by Homer); ἕκαστος ἐπίστασθε (Xenophon Historicus):—;the singular is also put in apposition with a pl. Noun, Τρῶας ἕκαστον ὑπήλυθε τρόμος (for Τρώων ἕκαστον)) fear seized them every one , (Iliad by Homer) 2. in plural all and each one , (Homer) 3. more definitely, εἷς ἕκαστος, Lat. unusquisque, every single one, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.:—; καθ᾽ ἕκαστον singly, by itself , Lat. singulatim, (Plato Philosophus), etc. 4. ὡς ἕκαστοι each by himself , (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)
G1538.ks: 모든 사람 하나하나, 곧 각자를 뜻하는 형용사. 단수로 쓰이면서 복수 동사와 함께 나오기도 한다.

G1539.ks: 매번, 항상이라는 뜻의 부사. 신약에서 베드로후서 1장 15절에만 나온다.

G1540.d: ἑκατόν, οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl., a hundred: Mat.13:8, 23 Luk.15:4, al.; κατὰ ἑ, Mrk.6:40; εἰς, ἐν ἑ., Mrk.4:8, 20 (AS)
G1540.ks: 숫자 100을 뜻하는 불변화 수사. 마태복음 13장 8절 등에 나온다.

G1541.d: ἑκατονταετής (Rec. έτης), -ές (ἑκατόν, ἔτης) [in LXX for שָׁנֶה מֵאָה בֵּן, Gen.17:17 * ;] a hundred years old: Rom.4:19.† (AS)
G1541.ks: 나이가 백 세라는 뜻의 형용사. 신약에서 로마서 4장 19절에만 나온다.

G1542.d: a hundred times as much or many , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)
G1542.ks: 백 배나 되는 양이나 수를 뜻하는 형용사.

G1543.ks: 로마 군대에서 백 명을 거느리는 지휘관을 뜻한다. 복음서와 사도행전에 자주 나온다.

G1544.d: ἐκ-βάλλω [in LXX chiefly for גָּרַשׁ pi., also for שָׁלַךְ hi., יָצָא hi., יָרַשׁ hi., etc. ;] 1. to drive, cast or send out, to expel: with accusative of thing(s), mid. (σῖτον), before εἰς, Act.27:38; pass., Mat.15:17; with accusative of person(s), Mat.21:12, Mrk.11:15, al.; δαιμόνια, Mat.7:22, Mrk.1:34, al.; id. before ἐκ, Mrk.7:26; παρά, Mrk.16:9; ἐν, Mrk.3:22; (ἐν) τ. ὀνόματι, Mat.7:22, Mrk.9:38; λόγῳ, Mat.8:16; before ἔξω, Jhn.6:37; id. with genitive, Mrk.12:8, al.; of expulsion from home, Gal.4:30; from the Church, III Jn 10. 2. In LXX and NT (like Heb. יָצָא and Aram. הַנְפֵּק), to command or cause to depart: Mat.9:38, Mrk.1:12 (see Swete, in l.), ib. Mrk.1:43 5:40, Luk.10:2, Jas.2:25; τ. κρίσιν εἰς νῖκος (to cause to proceed to its goal), Mat.12:20 (LXX). 3. to reject (cl.): τ. ὄνομα ὑμῶς ὡς πονηρόν (cf. Deu.25:14), Luk.6:22; to leave out, Rev.11:2. 4. to take, draw or pluck out; (a) with violence: Mat.7:5, Mrk.9:47, Luk.6:42; (b) to bring forth or out of: Mat.12:35, Luk.10:35. (AS)
G1544.ks: 밖으로 내쫓거나 내보내다라는 뜻의 동사. 귀신을 쫓아낼 때도 자주 쓰인다.

G1545.d: ἔκ-βασις, -εως, ἡ (ἐκβαίνω), [in LXX: Wis.2:17 8:8 11:14 * ;] 1. a way out (Hom., Xen.): 1Co.10:13. 2. the issue (Menand.) Heb.13:7.† (AS)
G1545.ks: 빠져나가는 길이나 결과를 뜻한다. 고린도전서 10장 13절과 히브리서 13장 7절에 나온다.

G1546.d: ἐκ-βολή, -ῆς (ἐκβάλλω), [in LXX: Exo.11:1 (גָּרַשׁ), Jos.1:5 (ἐκβολὴν ποιεῖσθαι, טול hi.), Eze.47:8 (יָצָא)* ;] 1. a throwing out. 2. a jettison, a throwing overboard of cargo: Act.27:18 (cf. Jos, l.with; and see Field, Notes, 144 f.).† (AS)
G1546.ks: 배의 짐을 바다에 던지는 일을 뜻한다. 신약에서 사도행전 27장 18절에만 나온다.

G1549.d: ἔκ-γονος, -ον (ἐκγίγνομαι, to be born of), [in LXX for פְּרִי (neut.), בֵּן, etc. ;] 1. with genitive, born of. 2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ ἔ., a child, son or daughter; in pl., descendants: τέκνα ἢ ἔ., children or grand-children, 1Ti.5:4.† (AS)
G1549.ks: 누구에게서 태어난 자, 곧 자녀나 자손을 뜻한다. 디모데전서 5장 4절에서 손자를 가리킨다.

G1550.d: εκ-δαπανάω, -ῶ strengthened form of δαπανάω, to spend wholly; pass., with reflexive force, to spend oneself wholly: before ὑπέρ, 2Co.12:15.† (AS)
G1550.ks: 전부 다 써 버리다라는 뜻의 동사. 고린도후서 12장 15절에서 자신을 다 쓴다는 뜻으로 나온다.

G1551.d: ἐκ-δέχομαι [in LXX for עֶרֶב, קָבַץ, etc. ;] 1. to take or receive from (Hom., Hdt., a1.). 2. (Rare in cl.), to expect, await: with accusative of thing(s), Jhn.5:3, Heb.11:10, Jas.5:7; with accusative of person(s), Act.17:16, 1Co.11:33 16:11; before ἕως, Heb.10:13 (Cremer, 687).† (AS)
G1551.ks: 기다리거나 고대하다라는 뜻의 동사. 요한복음 5장 3절, 히브리서 11장 10절 등에 나온다.

G1552.d: ἔκ-δηλος, -ον (δῆλος), [in LXX: 3Ma.3:19 3Mac 6:5 * ;] strengthened form of δῆλος, which see, quite clear, evident: 2Ti.3:9.† (AS)
G1552.ks: 아주 분명하고 명백하다는 뜻의 형용사. 신약에서 디모데후서 3장 9절에만 나온다.

G1553.d: ἐκ-δημέω, -ῶ (ἔκδημος, from home; cf. -ία, 3Ma.4:11)*; to be from home, absent: 2Co.5:6; before ἀπό, 2Co.5:8; before ἐκ, 2Co.5:9 (cf. ἀπο-, ἐνδημέω).† (AS)
G1553.ks: 본향을 떠나 있다는 뜻의 동사. 고린도후서 5장 6~9절에 나온다.

G1554.d: ἐκ-δίδωμι [in LXX for נָתַן, etc. ;] 1. to surrender, give up, give out. 2. to let out for hire (Hdt.); mid. (as frequently in π.; see MM, Exp., xii); to let out to one's advantage, Mat.21:33, 41, Mrk.12:1, Luk.20:9.† (AS)
G1554.ks: 땅 등을 세를 받고 빌려주다라는 뜻의 동사. 포도원 비유(마 21장, 막 12장, 눅 20장)에 나온다.

G1555.d: ἐκ-δι-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι depon., [in LXX chiefly for סָפַר, pi. ;] to tell in detail, relate, declare: Act.13:41 (LXX) Act.15:3.† (AS)
G1555.ks: 자세히 이야기하여 알리다라는 뜻의 동사. 사도행전 13장 41절과 15장 3절에 나온다.

G1556.d: ἐκδικέω, -ῶ (ἔκδικος), [in LXX for פָּקַד, נָקַם, שָׁפַט, etc. ;] 1. to vindicate: with accusative of person(s), Luk.18:3, 5. 2. to avenge: with accusative of person(s), ἑαυτούς, Rom.12:19; with accusative of thing(s), παρακοήν, 2Co.10:6; αἷμα, Rev.6:10 19:2 (Cremer, 203; for exx. from π. in both senses, see MM, Exp., xii).† (AS)
G1556.ks: 신원하다 또는 복수하다라는 뜻의 동사. 누가복음 18장 3절, 로마서 12장 19절 등에 나온다.

G1557.d: ἐκ-δίκησις, -εως, ἡ (ἐκδικέω), [in LXX chiefly for נָקָם ;] vengeance, vindication: Luk.21:22, Rom.12:19 (see MM, Exp., xii), Heb.10:30 (LXX), 2Co.7:11; of the injured person, with genitive, Luk.18:7-8; with dative, Act.7:24; of the offender, with genitive obj., 1Pe.2:14; with dative, 2Th.1:8 (cf. Sir.12:6).† (AS)
G1557.ks: 신원이나 복수를 뜻한다. 누가복음 21장 22절, 로마서 12장 19절, 히브리서 10장 30절 등에 나온다.

G1558.d: ἔκδικος, -ον (δίκη), [in LXX: Wis.12:12, Sir.30:6, 4Ma.15:29 * ;] 1. without law, unjust. 2. exacting penalty from; as subst., an avenger: Rom.13:4; before περί, 1Th.4:6 (in π., a legal representative; Milligan, Th., l.with).† (AS)
G1558.ks: 죄를 벌하는 자, 곧 복수하는 자를 뜻한다. 로마서 13장 4절과 데살로니가전서 4장 6절에 나온다.

G1559.d: ἐκ-διώκω [in LXX for בָּרַח hi., צָמַת, הָדַף, etc. ;] to chase away, drive out: 1Th.2:15 (cf. Deu.6:19, Jol.2:20).† (AS)
G1559.ks: 몰아내다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 데살로니가전서 2장 15절에만 나온다.

G1560.d: ἔκ-δοτος, -ον (ἐκδίδωμι), [in LXX: Da TH Bel 1:22 * ;] given up, delivered over: Act.2:23 (for construction, see Field, Notes, 111 f.).† (AS)
G1560.ks: 넘겨진, 내어준 바 된다는 뜻의 형용사. 신약에서 사도행전 2장 23절에만 나온다.

G1561.d: ἐκ-δοχή ῆς, ἡ (ἐκδέχομαι); 1. in cl., (a) a receiving from, succession; (b) an interpretation. 2. In NT, = προσδοκία, expectation: Heb.10:27 (cf. Field, Notes, 231; Cremer, 688).† (AS)
G1561.ks: 기다림이나 기대를 뜻한다. 신약에서 히브리서 10장 27절에만 나온다.

G1562.d: ἐκ-δύω [in LXX chiefly for פָּשַׁט ;] to take of, strip of, strip: with accusative of person(s) (sc. clothing), Mat.27:28; with accusative of person(s) and of thing(s), Mat.27:31, Mrk.15:20, Luk.10:30; mid., to put off: figuratively, of the body, 2Co.5:4.† (AS)
G1562.ks: 옷을 벗기다라는 뜻의 동사. 마태복음 27장 28절과 31절, 누가복음 10장 30절 등에 나온다.

G1563.d: ἐκεῖ adv., [in LXX chiefly for שָׁם ;] 1. properly, of place, there: Mat.2:13 5:24, al.; οἱ ἐ., Mat.26:71; οὗ . . . ἐ., Mat.6:21 18:20 24:28, Mrk.6:10, Luk.12:34; pleonastic, ὅπου . . . ἐ. (= שָׁם אֲשֶׁר, Deu.4:5, al.), Rev.12:6, 14 (cf. Bl., § 50, 4). 2. As often in cl. (Hdt., Thuc., al.), with verbs of motion, for ἐκεῖσε, thither: Mat.2:22 17:20 24:28 26:36, Mrk.6:33, Luk.12:18 17:37 21:2, Jhn.11:8 18:2-3, Rom.15:24 (AS)
G1563.ks: 장소를 가리키는 '거기'를 뜻하는 부사. 신약에 자주 나온다.

G1564.d: ἐκεῖθεν adv., [in LXX chiefly for שָׁם ;] 1. of place, thence: Mat.4:21, Mrk.6:1, al. 2. Of time, thereafter (see: κἀκεῖθεν). (AS)
G1564.ks: 장소를 가리키는 '거기서부터'를 뜻하는 부사. 마태복음 4장 21절 등에 나온다.

G1565.d: ἐκεῖνος, -η, -ο (ἐκεῖ), [in LXX chiefly for הַהוּא ,הוּא, and cogn. forms ;] demonstr. pron., that person or thing (ille), implying remoteness as compared with οὗτος (hic); 1. absol., emphatic he, she, it: opposite to οὗτος, Luk.18:14, Jas.4:15; ἡμεῖς, Heb.12:25; ὑμεῖς, Mrk.4:11; ἄλλοι, Jhn.9:9; ἐγώ, Jhn.3:30; to persons named, Mk 16:[10, 13, 20], Jhn.2:21; of one (absent) who is not named, contemptuously (Abbott, JG, §§2385, 2732), Jhn.7:11 9:28; with respect, of Christ, 1Jo.2:6 3:3, al.; referring to a preceding noun, Mrk.16:[10], Jhn.7:45; resumption of a participial subject, Jhn.1:33 9:37 10:1, Rom.14:14, al. (on its reference in Jhn.19:35, see Westc, in l.; Moffatt, Intr., 568; Sanday, Fourth Gospel, 77ff.). 2. As adj., joined, like οὗτος, to a noun with the article: Mat.7:25, Mrk.3:24, Jhn.18:15, al.; esp. of time, past or future: ἐν τ. ἡμέραις ἐ., Mat.3:1, Mrk.1:9, Act.2:18" (LXX), al.; ἐν ἐ. τ. ἡμέρᾳ, esp of the Parousia, Mat.7:22, Luk.6:23, 2Th.1:10, 2Ti.1:12; adverbially, ἐκεινής (sc. ὁδοῦ) = cl. ἐκεινῇ (Bl., §36, 13), that way, Luk.19:4. (AS)
G1565.ks: 멀리 있는 사람이나 사물을 가리키는 지시대명사. οὗτος(이)와 대비된다.

G1566.d: ἐκεῖσε adv., [in LXX: Job.39:29 שָׁם * ;] thither: Act.21:3; constr. pregn. (MM, Exp., xii; Field, Notes, 134), τοὺς ἐ. ὄντας, Act.22:5.† (AS)
G1566.ks: 장소를 가리키는 '그리로'를 뜻하는 부사. 사도행전 21장 3절과 22장 5절에 나온다.

G1567.d: ἐκ-ζητέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for דָּרַשׁ, also for נָצַר, בָּקַשׁ, etc. ;] 1. to seek out or after, search for: with accusative of person(s) (1Ma.9:26); figuratively, τ. κύριον, θεόν (cf. Psa.14:2, Amo.5:4, al.), Act.15:17, Rom.3:11, Heb.11:6; εὐλογίαν, Heb.12:17; ἐξεζήτησαν κ. ἐξηραύνησαν (as in 1Ma.9:26), sought and searched out: 1Pe.1:10. 2. As in 2Ki.4:11, Eze.3:18, 20 al. (דָּרַשׁ), to demand, require: Luk.11:50-51 † (AS)
G1567.ks: 찾아내려고 구하다라는 뜻의 동사. 하나님을 찾는다고 할 때 쓰인다(행 15:17, 롬 3:11, 히 11:6).

G1568.d: ἐκ-θαμβέω, -ῶ (ἔκθαμβος), [in LXX: Sir.30:9 * ;] 1. to be amazed. 2. to amaze, terrify (Sir.30:9). Pass., to be amazed, terrified: Mrk.9:15 14:33 16:5-6.† (AS)
G1568.ks: 크게 놀라거나 두려워하다라는 뜻의 동사. 마가복음 9장 15절과 14장 33절 등에 나온다.

G1569.d: ἔκ-θαμβος, -ον (θάμβος), [in LXX: Wis.10:19, Da TH Dan.7:7 (dreadful, terrible: אֵמְתָּנִי) * ;] amazed (cf. Polyb., xx, 10, 9): Act.3:11.† (AS)
G1569.ks: 몹시 놀랐다는 뜻의 형용사. 신약에서 사도행전 3장 11절에만 나온다.

G1570.d: ἔκ-θετος, -ον (ἐκτίθημι), [in Al.: Eze.42:3 * ;] cast out: ποιεῖν ἔ. = ἐκτιθέναι, Act.7:19.† (AS)
G1570.ks: 버려진, 내던져진다는 뜻의 형용사. 사도행전 7장 19절에 나온다.

G1571.d: ἐκ-καθαίρω [in LXX for בָּעַר, etc. ;] 1. to cleanse thoroughly, cleanse out: with accusative, ἑαυτόν, 2Ti.2:21; of the impurity removed, ζυμήν, 1Co.5:7.† (AS)
G1571.ks: 철저히 정결하게 하다라는 뜻의 동사. 디모데후서 2장 21절과 고린도전서 5장 7절에 나온다.

G1572.d: ἐκ-καίω [in LXX chiefly for בָּעַר ;] 1. to burn up. 2. to kindle. Pass., to burn: metaphorically, of the passions (cf. Sir.16:6, Job.3:17), Rom.1:27.† (AS)
G1572.ks: 불이 붙어 타오르다라는 뜻의 동사. 로마서 1장 27절에서 욕정이 불타는 것을 가리킨다.

G1573.d: ἐκκακέω, -ῶ, see: ἐνκακέω. ἐν-κακέω, -ῶ (LTr., ἐγκ-; Rec. ἐκκ-; cf. WH, Notes, 157 f.; κακός, cowardly), [in Sm.: Gen.27:46, Num.21:5, Pro.3:11, Isa.7:16 *;] to lose heart : Luk.18:1, 2Co.4:1,16, Gal.6:9, Eph.3:13, 2Th.3:13 (Cremer, 330).† (AS)
G1573.ks: 용기를 잃고 낙심하다라는 뜻의 동사. 누가복음 18장 1절, 고린도후서 4장 1절, 갈라디아서 6장 9절 등에 나온다.

G1574.d: ἐκ-κεντέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for דָּקַר ;] 1. to prick out, put out (Arist.). 2. to pierce (Polyb., LXX): with accusative of person(s), Jhn.19:37 (LXX), Rev.1:7.† (AS)
G1574.ks: 창 등으로 찌르다라는 뜻의 동사. 요한복음 19장 37절과 요한계시록 1장 7절에 나온다.

G1575.d: ἐκ-κλάω, -ῶ [in LXX: Lev.1:17 (שָׁסַע pi.)* ;] to break off: pass., Rom.11:17-20.† (AS)
G1575.ks: 가지 등이 꺾이다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 로마서 11장 17~20절에 나온다.

G1576.d: ἐκ-κλείω [in LXX: ἐ. κρίσιν, for נָטָה hi., Exo.23:2 (also as seel., Job.34:20, Psa.67:1-7 (Psa.68:30) * ;] to shut out: Gal.4:17. Pass., Rom.3:27.† (AS)
G1576.ks: 밖으로 닫아 걸다, 곧 배제하다라는 뜻의 동사. 갈라디아서 4장 17절과 로마서 3장 27절에 나온다.

G1577.d: ἐκκλησία, -ας, ἡ (ἐκ-καλέω), [in LXX chiefly for קָהָל, otherwise for one of its cogn. forms ;] 1. prop., an assembly of citizens regularly convened (in Thuc., ii, 22, opposite to σύλλογος, a concourse): Act.19:32, 39 41. 2. In LXX of the assembly, congregation, community of Israel (Deu.4:10 23:2, al.): Act.7:38, Heb.2:12" (LXX) . 3. NT, esp. of an assembly or company of Christians, a (the) church; (a) of gatherings for worship: 1Co.11:18 14:19, 34 35; (b) of local communities: Act.8:3, 1Co.4:17; with name added, Act.8:1, Rom.16:1, 1Th.1:1, al.; pl., Act.15:41, 1Co.7:17; τ. Χριστοῦ, Rom.16:16; τ. Ἀσίας, 1Co.16:19; τ. ἁγίων, 1Co.14:33; εἰπο]ν τ. ἐκκλησίᾳ, Mat.18:17 (but see Hort, Ecclesia, 10); of a house-congregation (DB, i, 431a), Rom.16:5, 1Co.16:19, Col.4:15, Phm 2; (with) of the whole body of Christians: Mat.16:18, 1Co.12:28, Eph.1:22, Php.3:6, al.; τ. θεοῦ, Act.20:28 (Κυρίου, T, R, mg.), 1Co.15:9, Gal.1:13, 1Ti.3:15; ἐ. προτοτόκων ἀπογεγραμμένων ἐν οὐρανοῖς, Heb.12:23. SYN.: συναγωγή, which see (see Tr., Syn., §i; DB, i, 426; Hort, Ecclesia, esp. 4ff., 107ff.; Hamilton, People of God, ii, 37ff.; reff. s.vv. "Church," "Congregation," in DB and DCG; Cremer, 332). (AS)
G1577.ks: 본래 모임에 소집된 시민의 회중을 뜻한다. 칠십인역에서 이스라엘 회중을, 신약에서 그리스도인의 모임을 가리킨다.

G1578.d: ἐκ-κλίνω [in LXX for נָטָה, סוּר, etc. ;] intrans., to turn aside, turn away: metaphorically, from the right path, absol., Rom.3:12 (LXX); from evil, absol., 1Pe.3:11; before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), Rom.16:17.† (AS)
G1578.ks: 옆으로 돌아서다, 곧 악에서 돌이키다라는 뜻의 동사. 로마서 3장 12절과 베드로전서 3장 11절에 나온다.

G1579.ks: 물 밖으로 헤엄쳐 나오다라는 뜻의 동사.

G1580.d: ἐκ-κομίζω to carry out: as freq., a corpse for burial, Luk.7:12.† (AS)
G1580.ks: 시체를 장사하려고 메고 나가다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 누가복음 7장 12절에만 나온다.

G1581.d: ἐκ-κόπτω, [in LXX for כָּרַת, etc. ;] to cut out, cut off, cut down: of a hand, foot, Mat.5:30 18:8; a tree, Mat.3:10 7:19 Luk.3:9 13:7, 9; figuratively, of a branch, Rom.11:22; before ἐκ, Rom.11:24; metaphorically, τ. ἀφορμήν (cf. Job.19:10 ἐλπίδα), 2Co.11:12.† (AS)
G1581.ks: 잘라내거나 찍어 버리다라는 뜻의 동사. 손발이나 나무, 가지에 쓰이며 비유로도 쓰인다.

G1582.d: ἐκ-κρέμαννυμι, [in LXX for קָשַׁר, Gen.44:30 * ;] to hang from or upon; mid., ἐκκρέμαμαι: figuratively, ἐξεκρέματο αὐτοῦ άκούων (Rec.; WH read ἐξεκρέμετο, which implies a Pres. ἐκκρέμομαι, otherwise unknown; cf. Veitch, see word κρέμαμαι), Luk.19:48.† (AS)
G1582.ks: 무엇에 매달리다라는 뜻의 동사. 누가복음 19장 48절에서 사람들이 말씀에 매달려 들었다고 한다.

G1583.d: ἐκ-λαλέω, -ῶ [in LXX: Jdth.11:9 * ;] to speak out, divulge: Act.23:22.† (AS)
G1583.ks: 밖으로 말하다, 곧 털어놓다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 사도행전 23장 22절에만 나온다.

G1584.d: ἐκ-λάμπω [in LXX for אוֹר hi., etc. ;] to shine forth: Mat.13:43.† (AS)
G1584.ks: 밖으로 빛을 내다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 마태복음 13장 43절에만 나온다.

G1585.d: ἐκ-λανθάνω [in Sm.: Psa.13:2 * ;] to escape notice utterly; mid., to forget utterly: Heb.12:5.† (AS)
G1585.ks: 완전히 잊어버리다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 히브리서 12장 5절에만 나온다.

G1586.d: ἐκ-λέγω [in LXX chiefly for בָּחַר ;] to pick out, choose. In NT always mid. (exc. Luk.9:35, ἐκλελεγμένος, WH, ἀγαπητός, R, mg.), to pick out for oneself, choose (cf. M, Pr., 157 f.): with accusative of thing(s), Luk.10:42 14:7; with accusative of person(s), Act.6:5 15:22, 25; of Christ (see supr.), Luk.9:35; of Christ's choice of disciples, Luk.6:13, Jhn.6:70 13:18 15:16, 19 Act.1:2; of the Divine choice: of persons, Mrk.13:20, Act.1:24 13:17 15:7, Eph.1:4, Jas.2:5; of things, 1Co.1:27-28 (Cremer, 402, 773).† (AS)
G1586.ks: 골라내어 자신을 위해 택하다라는 뜻의 동사. 그리스도가 제자들을 택하신 일에 쓰인다.

G1587.d: ἐκ-λείπω [in LXX for כָּלָה, כָּרַת ni., תָּמַם, etc., 47 different words in all ;] 1. trans., to leave out, pass over. 2. Intrans., to leave off, cease, fail: μαμωνᾶς, Luk.16:9; πίστις, Luk.22:32; ἔτη, Heb.1:12 (LXX); of the sun in an eclipse, Luk.23:45.† (AS)
G1587.ks: 그치거나 다하다라는 뜻의 동사. 누가복음 16장 9절, 22장 32절, 23장 45절 등에 나온다.

G1588.d: ἐκ-λεκτός, -ή, -όν (ἐκλέγω), [in LXX for בָּחַר (so prob. in Isa.28:16, Pro.17:3, for MT בָּחַן), בָּרִיא, etc. ;] 1. choice, select (cl., rarely; Thuc., Plat., al.), hence, eminent: Rom.16:13 (cf. Eze.27:24). 2. As in Inscr. (MM, Exp., xii), chosen; esp. as in LXX, of Israel, elect, chosen of God (Isa.65:9, Psa.105:43, al.); so in NT; (a) of Christ: Luk.23:35 (cf. Isa.42:1); figuratively, λίθος, 1Pe.2:4-6 (LXX); (b) of holy angels: 1Ti.5:21; (with) of Christians: Mat.24:22, 24, Mrk.13:20, 22 13:27, 2Ti.2:10, 1Pe.1:1; τ. θεοῦ, Luk.18:7, Rom.8:33, Col.3:12, Tit.1:1; τ. Χριστοῦ, Mat.24:31; ἐ. κυρία, II Jn 1; ἀδελφή, II Jn 13; γένος, 1Pe.2:9 (LXX); κλητοὶ καὶ ἐ. κ. πιστοί, Rev.17:14; opposite to κλητός (not so in Epp.; see Lft. on Col.3:12), Mat.20:16 (T, WH, txt., R, omit) Mat.22:14 (Cremer, 405, 775).† (AS)
G1588.ks: 택함을 받은 자를 뜻하는 형용사. 이스라엘과 그리스도, 성도를 가리키는 데 쓰인다.

G1589.d: ἐκλογή, ῆς ἡ (ἐκλέγω), [in Aq.: Isa.22:7; Sm., Th.: Isa.37:24 * ;] a choice, selection; in NT, always of the Divine choice (EV, election): σκεῦος ἐκλογῆς, genitive qual., a chosen vessel; κατ ἐ., Rom.9:11 11:5, 28; with genitive of person(s), 1Th.1:4, 2Pe.1:10; by meton., ἡ ἐ. = οἱ ἐκλεκτοί, Rom.11:7.† (AS)
G1589.ks: 선택, 곧 하나님께서 택하시는 일을 뜻한다. 로마서 9장 11절, 11장 5절과 28절 등에 나온다.

G1590.d: ἐκ-λύω [in LXX for רָפָה, etc. ;] 1. to loose, release. 2. to unloose, as a bow-string, to relax, enfeeble; pass., to be faint, grow weary: Mat.15:32, Mrk.8:3; of mental weariness, Gal.6:9, Heb.12:3, 5" (LXX) .† (AS)
G1590.ks: 기운이 빠지거나 피곤하여 지치다라는 뜻의 동사. 마태복음 15장 32절과 갈라디아서 6장 9절 등에 나온다.

G1591.d: ἐκ-μάσσω [in LXX: Sir.12:11, Ep. Jer.13:1-27 24:1-10 * ;] to wipe off: with accusative, Luk.7:38, 44, Jhn.11:2 12:3 13:5.† (AS)
G1591.ks: 닦아 없애다라는 뜻의 동사. 누가복음 7장 38절과 요한복음 11장 2절, 12장 3절, 13장 5절에 나온다.

G1592.d: ἐκ-μυκτηρίζω [in LXX: Psa.2:4 22:7 35:16 (לָעַג), I Est.1:51 A* ;] to hold up the nose in derision at, scoff at: with accusative, Luk.16:14 23:35.† (AS)
G1592.ks: 코웃음 치며 조롱하다라는 뜻의 동사. 누가복음 16장 14절과 23장 35절에 나온다.

G1593.d: ἐκ-νεύω [in LXX: Jdg.4:18 (סוּר) Jdg.18:26, 4Ki.2:24 23:16 (פָּנָה), Mic.6:14 (סוּג hi.), 3Ma.3:22 * ;] 1. to bend the head aside (Xen.). 2. (a) to shun, avoid (Diod.); (b) to withdraw: Jhn.5:13† (AS)
G1593.ks: 피해 물러나다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 요한복음 5장 13절에만 나온다.

G1594.d: ἐκ-νήφω [in LXX: Gen.9:24, Hab.2:7 (יָקַץ), Jol.1:5, Hab.2:19 (יָקַץ hi.), 1Ki.25:37 (יָצָא), Sir.31:2 * ;] to become sober after drunkenness: metaphorically, of sobriety of mind, 1Co.15:34.† (AS)
G1594.ks: 술 취한 후에 정신을 차리다라는 뜻의 동사. 고린도전서 15장 34절에서 깨어난다는 비유로 쓰인다.

G1595.d: ἐκούσιος, -ον (έκών), [in LXX chiefly for נְדָבָה, as Num.15:3 (κατ᾽ ἑ) ;] usually of actions, voluntary: κατὰ ἑ., of free will (Lft., in l), Phm 14.† (AS)
G1595.ks: 스스로 원하는, 곧 자발적이라는 뜻의 형용사. 빌레몬서 14절에서 자의로라는 뜻으로 쓰인다.

G1596.ks: 기꺼이 자발적으로라는 뜻의 부사. 히브리서 10장 26절과 베드로전서 5장 2절에 나온다.

G1597.d: ἔκ-παλαι adv. (of a class of compound adverbs common in late Gk.; see Mayor on 2 Pe, l.with), for a long time, from of old: 2Pe.2:3 3:5.† (AS)
G1597.ks: 오래 전부터라는 뜻의 부사. 베드로후서 2장 3절과 3장 5절에 나온다.

G1598.d: ἐκ-πειράζω [in LXX: Deu.6:16 8:2, 16 Psa.78:18 (נָסָה pi.) * ;] = cl. ἐκπειράομαι, to put to the proof or test, make trial of, tempt: with accusative, of God, Mat.4:7 (LXX), Luk.4:12 (ib.), 1Co.10:9; of Christ, Luk.10:25 (Cremer, 497).† (AS)
G1598.ks: 시험하거나 떠보다라는 뜻의 동사. 하나님을 시험한다고 할 때 쓰인다(마 4:7, 눅 4:12, 고전 10:9).

G1599.d: ἐκ-πέμπω [in LXX for שָׁלַח ;] to send forth: Act.13:4 17:10.† (AS)
G1599.ks: 밖으로 보내다라는 뜻의 동사. 사도행전 13장 4절과 17장 10절에 나온다.

G1600.d: ἐκ-πετάννυμι [in LXX chiefly for פָּרַשׂ, as Isa.65:2 (hithp.) ;] to spread out (as a sail), stretch forth: Rom.10:21(LXX).† (AS)
G1600.ks: 돛처럼 펴다, 손을 뻗어 내밀다라는 뜻의 동사. 로마서 10장 21절(칠십인역 인용)에 나온다.

G1601.d: ἐκ-πίπτω [in LXX: Isa.40:8 28:1, 4 (הֶבֶל), Job.14:2 (מָלַל, see RV. mg), Job.15:30 (סוּר), Job.15:33 (שָׁלַךְ hi.), etc. ;] to fall out of, fall from, fall off: before ἐκ τ. χειρῶν, Act.12:7; absol., Act.27:32; of the withering of flowers (as LXX, ll with), Jas.1:11, 1Pe.1:24" (LXX) ; of navigators falling off from a straight course, Act.27:17, 26 27:29 Metaphorical, with genitive of thing(s): Gal.5:4, 2Pe.3:17; absol., fall from its place, fail, perish: Rom.9:6.† (AS)
G1601.ks: 밖으로 떨어지거나 떨어져 나가다라는 뜻의 동사. 꽃이 시드는 것과 항로를 벗어나는 것에도 쓰인다.

G1602.d: ἐκ-πλέω, -ῶ to sail away: Act.20:6; before εἰς, Act.15:39 18:18.† (AS)
G1602.ks: 배를 타고 떠나다라는 뜻의 동사. 사도행전 15장 39절, 18장 18절, 20장 6절에 나온다.

G1603.d: ἐκ-πληρόω [in LXX: 2Ma.8:10, 3Ma.1:2 3Mac 1:22 * ;] 1. to fill full, make up a number. 2. to fulfil (MM, Exp., xii; Cremer, 839), Act.13:32.† (AS)
G1603.ks: 채우다, 또는 이루다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 사도행전 13장 32절에만 나온다.

G1604.ks: 끝마침이나 성취를 뜻한다. 신약에서 사도행전 21장 26절에만 나온다.

G1605.d: ἐκ-πλήσσω (Attic -ττω, Act.13:12), [in LXX: (pass.) Ecc.7:16, (שָׁמֵם hithp.), Wis.13:4, 2Ma.7:12, 4Ma.8:4 4Mac 17:16 * ;] 1. prop., to strike out, drive away. 2. to strike with panic or shock, to amaze, astonish: pass., Mat.13:54 19:25, Mrk.6:2 7:37 10:26, Luk.2:48; before ἐπί, with dative of thing(s), Mat.7:28 22:33, Mrk.1:22 11:18, Luk.4:32 9:43, Act.13:12.† SYN.: " πτωεῖν G?, to terrify, agitate with fear; τρεμεῖν, to tremble, predominantly physical; φοβεῖν, to fear, "the general term," Thayer; cf. also φρίσσω, to shudder, and see: δειλία δειλία, -ας, ἡ (δειλός), [in LXX for אֵימָה, מְחִתָּה, etc. ;] cowardice, timidity (never in good sense): 2Ti.1:7.† SYN.: φόβος, fear, in general, good or bad; εὐλάβεια (which see), apprehension generally, but chiefly pious fear, "that careful and watchful reverence which pays regard to every circumstance in that with which it has to deal" (cf. Tr., Syn., § x).† (AS)
G1605.ks: 충격을 받아 몹시 놀라다라는 뜻의 동사. 예수님의 가르침에 사람들이 놀란 장면에 자주 쓰인다.

G1606.d: ἐκ-πνέω, -ῶ, to breathe out; sc. βίον, ψυχήν (expressed in cl., Æsch., al.; cf. LS, see word), to breathe one's last, expire: Mrk.15:37, 39 Luk.23:46. For force of aorist, see Swete, Mrk.15:37.† (AS)
G1606.ks: 숨을 내쉬다, 곧 최후의 숨을 거두다라는 뜻의 동사. 마가복음 15장 37절과 누가복음 23장 46절에 나온다.

G1607.d: ἐκ-πορεύω [in LXX chiefly for יָצָא ;] to make to go out; pass. and mid., to go forth: Luk.3:7, Act.25:4; of demons leaving one possessed, Mat.17:21 (WH om.), Act.19:12; of excrement, Mk 719; before ἀπό, Mat.20:29, Mrk.10:46; ἐκ, Mrk.13:1 (of the dead rising, Jhn.5:29); ἐκεῖθεν, Mrk.6:11; ἔξω, Mrk.11:19; είς, Mrk.10:17, Jhn.5:29; ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Rev.16:14; πρός, with accusative of person(s), Mat.3:5, Mrk.1:5; εἰσπορ- (which see) καὶ ἐ., Act.9:28; metaphorically, to come forth, proceed: of feelings, etc., Mrk.7:23; before ἐκ, Mat.15:11, 18 Mrk.7:15, 20-21, Luk.4:22, Eph.4:29; ῥῆμα, before διά, Mat.4:4 (LXX); of lightning and flame, Rev.4:5 9:17-18 11:5; a river, Rev.22:1; a sword, Rev.1:16 19:15; a rumour, before εἰς, Luk.4:37; of the Holy Spirit, before παρά, Jhn.15:26.† (AS)
G1607.ks: 밖으로 나가다라는 뜻의 동사. 사람이나 귀신이 나가거나 입에서 나오는 것에도 쓰인다.

G1608.d: ἐκ-πορνεύω [in LXX chiefly for זָנָה, frequently of spiritual unfaithfulness ;] strengthened form of πoρνεύω, implying excessive indulgence; mid, to give oneself up to fornication: Ju 7.† (AS)
G1608.ks: 음행에 몰두하다라는 뜻의 강조형 동사. 신약에서 유다서 7절에만 나온다.

G1609.d: ἐκ-πτύω 1. to spit out. 2. to spit at in disgust, to abominate, loathe (= cl. ἀποπτ-, καταπτ-): Gal.4:14.† (AS)
G1609.ks: 침을 뱉다, 곧 혐오하여 물리치다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 갈라디아서 4장 14절에만 나온다.

G1610.d: ἐκ-ριζόω, -ῶ [in LXX: Jdg.5:14 (שֶׁרֶשׁ), Jer.1:10 (נָתַשׁ), Zep.2:4 (גָּרַשׁ A, עָקַר BS), Dan.7:8 (עָקַר), Dan LXX 4:11, 23, Wis.4:4, Sir.3:9 49:7, 1Ma.5:51, 2Ma.12:7 * ;] to root out, pluck up by the roots: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.13:29 15:13 Luk.17:6, Ju 12.† (AS)
G1610.ks: 뿌리째 뽑아내다라는 뜻의 동사. 마태복음 13장 29절, 15장 13절, 누가복음 17장 6절, 유다서 12절에 나온다.

G1611.d: ἔκ-στασις, -εως, ἡ (ἐξίστημι) [in LXX: Gen.27:33, 1Ki.14:15, Eze.26:16, al. (חֲרָדָה); 2Ch.14:14 17:10 20:29 (פַּחַד), al. ;] 1. a displacement (Arist.). 2. An abnormal condition of the mind, in which the subject passes out of his usual self-control (Hippocr.); in NT (Kennedy, Sources, 121 f.); (a) a trance: Act.10:10 11:5 22:17; (b) amazement: Mrk.5:42 16:8, Luk.5:26, Act.3:19.† (AS)
G1611.ks: 평소의 정신 상태를 벗어난 상태를 뜻한다. 환상 중의 황홀경과 크게 놀라는 것을 가리킨다.

G1612.d: ἐκ-στρέφω [in LXX: Deu.32:20, Amo.6:13 Eze.16:34 A (הָפַךְ), Za 11:16 (פָּרַק pi.), Eze.13:20 (צוּד pi.)* ;] 1. to turn out of (Hom.). 2. to turn inside out; metaphorically, to change entirely, pervert (Aristoph.): Tit.3:11.† (AS)
G1612.ks: 완전히 바뀌어 비뚤어지다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 디도서 3장 11절에만 나온다.

G1613.d: ἐκ-ταράσσω [in LXX: Psa.18:4 (עֵת pi.), Psa.88:16 (צוּם), צוּם), Wis.17:3-4 18:17 * ;] to throw into great trouble, agitate: Act.16:20.† (AS)
G1613.ks: 큰 혼란에 빠뜨리다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 사도행전 16장 20절에만 나온다.

G1614.d: ἐκ-τείνω [in LXX for שָׁלַח, נָטָה, etc. ;] to stretch out or forth: τ. χεῖρα (as often in LXX), Mat.8:3 12:13 14:31 26:51, Mrk.1:41 3:5, Luk.5:13 6:10 Jhn.21:18, Act.26:1; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), towards, Mat.12:49; against, Luk.22:53; εἰς ἴασιν, Act.4:30; of anchors, to cast, Act.27:30.† (AS)
G1614.ks: 손을 내밀다, 펴다라는 뜻의 동사. 복음서에서 병을 고치실 때 손을 내미신다고 자주 쓰인다.

G1615.d: ἐκ-τελέω, -ῶ [in LXX: Deu.32:45 (כָּלָה), 2Ch.4:5, (Da TH Dan.3:40), 2Ma.15:9 * ;] to bring to an end, finish, complete: Luk.14:29-30.† (AS)
G1615.ks: 끝까지 이루어 마치다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 누가복음 14장 29~30절에 나온다.

G1616.d: ἐκ-τένεια, -ας, ἡ (ἐκτενής), [in LXX: Jdth.4:9, 2Ma.14:38, 3Ma.6:41 * ;] zeal, intentness, earnestness (cf. Deiss., BS, 262): Act.26:7.† (AS)
G1616.ks: 열심히 힘써 하는 마음을 뜻한다. 신약에서 사도행전 26장 7절에만 나온다.

G1617.d: deeply, earnestly intensely, fervently, earnestly, deeply Lk. 22:44; Acts 12:5; 1Pet. 1:22*
G1617.ks: 힘써서, 간절하게라는 뜻의 비교급 부사. 누가복음 22장 44절, 사도행전 12장 5절, 베드로전서 1장 22절에 나온다.

G1618.ks: 팽팽하게 뻗은, 곧 열심 있고 간절하다는 뜻의 형용사. 베드로전서 4장 8절에 나온다.

G1619.d: ἐκτενῶς adv., [in LXX: Jon.3.8 (חׇזְקָה), Jol.1:14, Jdth.4:12, 3Ma.5:9 * ;] fervently, earnestly: Act.12:5, 1Pe.1:22; compar., Luk.22:44 (WH br., R, mg., omits).† (AS)
G1619.ks: 열심히, 간절하게라는 뜻의 부사. 사도행전 12장 5절과 베드로전서 1장 22절에 나온다.

G1620.d: ἐκ-τίθημι [in LXX for נָתַן ni., etc. ;] to set out, expose: Act.7:21, Metaphorical, to set forth, expound: Act.11:4 28:23; with accusative of thing(s), Act.18:26.† (AS)
G1620.ks: 밖에 내놓다, 또는 풀어 설명하다라는 뜻의 동사. 사도행전 7장 21절, 11장 4절, 28장 23절에 나온다.

G1621.d: ἐκ-τινάσσω [in LXX for נָעַר ni., pi., etc. ;] to shake off: κονιορτόν, Mat.10:14; χοῦν, Mrk.6:11. Mid.: κονιορτόν, Act.13:51; ἱμάτια, Act.18:6 (cf. MM, Exp., iii).† (AS)
G1621.ks: 털어 버리다라는 뜻의 동사. 발의 먼지를 떨어 버리는 행위에 쓰인다(마 10:14, 막 6:11).

G1622.d: 1. outside , opposite to ἐντός: 2. as preposition with genitive outside, out of, far from , with genitive, (Homer): outside of, free from , (Herdotus Historicus), attic; ἐκτὸς ἐλπίδος beyond hope, Lat. praeter spem, (Sophocles Tragicus) 3. of Time, beyond , (Herdotus Historicus) 4. except , ἐκτὸς ὀλίγων (Xenophon Historicus) 5. absolute, τὰ ἐκτός external things , (Euripides) 6. with Verbs of motion, ῥίπτειν ἐκτός to throw out , (Sophocles Tragicus), etc. (ML)
G1622.ks: 밖이라는 뜻의 부사이며, 속격과 함께 쓰이면 '~밖에, ~외에'를 뜻하는 전치사.

G1623.d: ἐκτός, adv. [in LXX Jdg.8:26 20:15, 3Ki.10:13, al. (בַּד, Jdg.5:28 (בַּד), בַּד), Sng.4:1-3 (בַּד), al, ;] 1. as adv., outside, beyond: τὸ ἐ., with poss. genitive, the outside, Mat.23:26; in late Gk. (see Deiss., BS, 118), pleonastic, ἐκτός εἰ μή, 1Co.14:5 15:2, 1Ti.5:19. 2. With force of prep., with genitive; (a) outside of: 1Co.6:18, 2Co.12:2; (b) beyond, besides, except: Act.26:22, 1Co.15:27.† (AS)

G1624.d: ἐκ-τρέπω [in LXX for הָפַךְ, Amo.5:8 * ;] to turn out of the course, turn aside, with accusative Pass., with middle sense, intrans., to turn aside: Heb.12:13 (R, txt., for be put out of joint, R, mg., see Thayer, see word Westc., in l); figuratively, before εἰς, 1Ti.1:6; ἐπί, 2Ti.4:4; ὀπίσω, 1Ti.5:15; with accusative, to shun, avoid: 1Ti.6:20.† (AS)
G1624.ks: 길에서 벗어나 옆으로 돌아서다라는 뜻의 동사. 히브리서 12장 13절과 디모데전후서에 나온다.

G1625.d: ἐκ-τρέφω [in LXX for גָּדַל, etc. ;] 1. prop., of children, to nurture, bring up: Eph.6:4. 2. to nourish: Eph.5:29.† (AS)
G1625.ks: 기르고 돌보다라는 뜻의 동사. 에베소서 6장 4절과 5장 29절에 나온다.

G1626.d: ἔκ-τρωμα, -τος, τό (ἐκτιτρώσκω, to miscarry), [in LXX: Job.3:16, Ecc.6:3 (; also in Aq., Psa.58:9, Num.12:12 (נָפַל) * ;] an abortion, an untimely birth (see Field, Notes, 179): 1Co.15:8.† (AS)
G1626.ks: 달이 차기 전에 태어난 아이를 뜻한다. 신약에서 고린도전서 15장 8절에만 나온다.

G1627.d: ἐκ-φέρω [in LXX chiefly for יָצָא hi. ;] 1. to carry out, bring out: with accusative of thing(s), Luk.15:22, 1Ti.6:7; with accusative of person(s), Mrk.8:23, Act.5:15; of the dead for burial (cf. κομίζω), Act.5:6, 9-10. 2. to bring forth; (a) of women (Hipp., Arist., al.); (b) of the ground (Hdt.): Heb.6:8.† (AS)
G1627.ks: 밖으로 가지고 나가다, 또는 열매를 맺다라는 뜻의 동사. 시체를 메고 나가는 것에도 쓰인다.

G1628.d: ἐκ-φεύγω [in LXX for נוּס, etc. ;] to flee away, escape: absol., Act.16:27, 1Th.5:3, Heb.2:3; before ἐκ, Act.19:10; with accusative of person(s), Heb.12:25; with accusative of thing(s), Luk.21:36, Rom.2:3; τ. χεῖρας αὐτοῦ, 2Co.11:33.† (AS)
G1628.ks: 달아나 피하다라는 뜻의 동사. 사도행전 16장 27절, 데살로니가전서 5장 3절, 히브리서 2장 3절에 나온다.

G1629.d: ἐκ-φοβέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for חָרֵד hi. ;] to frighten away, terrify: with accusative of person(s), 2Co.10:9.† (AS)
G1629.ks: 겁을 주어 놀라게 하다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 고린도후서 10장 9절에만 나온다.

G1630.d: ἔκφοβος, -ον [in LXX: ἔ. εἶναι for יָגֹר, Deu.9:19; also 1Ma.13:2 * ;] affrighted, terrified: Mrk.9:16, Heb.12:21.† (AS)
G1630.ks: 몹시 두려워하는 상태를 뜻하는 형용사. 마가복음 9장 6절과 히브리서 12장 21절에 나온다.

G1631.d: ἐκ-φύω [in OT (Sm.) Psa.104:14; (Al.) Isa.61:11 * ;] to cause to grow out, put forth (leaves): Mat.24:32, Mrk.13:28.† (AS)
G1631.ks: 잎 등을 내게 하다라는 뜻의 동사. 마태복음 24장 32절과 마가복음 13장 28절에 나온다.

G1632.d: ἐκ-χέω also Hellenistic, ἐκχύνω (in Th.: 4Ki.14:14 *), and ἐκχύννω (which see) [in LXX chiefly for שָׁפַךְ ;] to pour out: φιάλην, Rev.16:1-4, 8 16:10, 12 16:17; κέρματα, Jhn.2:15; αἷμα, Mat.23:35 (cf. MM, Exp., xii), Luk.11:50, Act.22:20, Rom.3:15" (LXX) Rev.16:6. Pass., αἷμα, Mat.26:28, Mrk.14:24, Act.22:20; οἶνος, Mat.9:17, Luk.5:37; σπλάγχνα, Act.1:18. Metaphorical, τ. πνεῦμα, Act.2:17-18 (LXX), Act.2:33 10:45, Tit.3:6; ἀγάπη, Rom.5:5 (cf. Sir.36:8, ὀργήν); pass., of persons (like Lat. effundor), to give oneself up to (RV, ran riotously in): Ju 11.† (AS)
G1632.ks: 쏟아 붓다라는 뜻의 동사. 피, 포도주, 진노의 대접 등을 쏟는다고 할 때 쓰인다.

G1633.d: εκ-χύννω Hellenistic form of ἐκχέω, which see (E1., § 17): Mat.23:35 26:28, Mrk.14:24, Luk.5:37 11:50 22:20, Act.1:18 10:45 22:20, Rom.5:5, Ju 11.† ἐκ-χωρέω, -ῶ [in LXX: Num.16:45 (רוּם ni.), Jdg.7:3 (צָפַר), Amo.7:12 (בָּרַח), 1Es.4:44 Est.4:57, 1Ma.9:62 * ;] to depart, withdraw: Luk.21:21.† (AS)
G1633.ks: 떠나다, 물러나다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 누가복음 21장 21절에 나온다.

G1634.d: ἐκ-ψύχω [in LXX: Jdg.4:21 A (עוּף), Eze.21:7 (כָּהָה pi.)* ;] to expire, breathe one's last: Act.5:5, 10 12:23 (cf. ἐκπνέω; Cremer, 906).† (AS)
G1634.ks: 최후의 숨을 거두다라는 뜻의 동사. 사도행전 5장 5절과 10절, 12장 23절에 나온다.

G1635.d: ἑκών, -οῦσα, -όν [in LXX: Exo.21:13, Job.36:19 * ;] willing, of one's own free will: Rom.8:20, 1Co.9:17 (Cremer, 246).† (AS)
G1635.ks: 스스로 원하는, 곧 자의로 한다는 뜻의 형용사. 로마서 8장 20절과 고린도전서 9장 17절에 나온다.

G1636.d: ἐλαία (Attic, ἐλάα), -ας, ἡ [in LXX for זַיִת ;] 1. an olive tree: Rom.11:17, 24, Rev.11:4; τ. ὄρος τῶν ἐ. (זַיִת הַר, Zec.14:4), the Mount of Olives: Mat.21:1 24:3 26:30, Mrk.11:1 13:3 14:26, Luk.19:37 22:39; τὸ καλούμενον ἐ. (T, ἐλαιών, which see), Luk.19:29 21:37. 2. an olive (Aristoph.): Jas.3:12.† (AS)
G1636.ks: 올리브 나무를 뜻한다. 감람산이라는 이름과 로마서 11장의 비유에 나온다.

G1637.d: ἔλαιον, -ου, τό [in LXX chiefly for שֶׁמֶן ;] olive-oil: Luk.16:6, Rev.6:6 18:13; for lamps, Mat.25:3-4, 8; for healing, Mrk.6:13, Luk.10:34, Jhn.5:14; for anointing at feasts, Luk.7:46, Heb.1:9" (LXX) .† SYN.: μύρον, ointment, see Tr., Syn., 135 (AS)
G1637.ks: 올리브 기름을 뜻한다. 등불, 치료, 손님 접대 때의 바르는 기름 등에 쓰인다.

G1638.d: ἐλαιών, -ῶνος, ὁ (ἐλαία), [in LXX for זַיִת ;] olive-grove, olive-garden (so in FlJ and in π.; Deiss., BS, 209 ff.; MM, Exp., iii; M, Pr., 49, 69, 235): Luk.19:29 21:37 (WH, -ῶν; see their App., 158; Field, Notes, 73; El., § 10, 5; 33, 1; Thayer, see word), Act.1:12 (where EL, ll with, proposes the conjectural emendation ἐλαιῶν for -ῶνος).† (AS)

G1639.d: Ἐλαμείτης (Rec. -αμίτης), -ου, ὁ (Heb. אֵילָם) [in LXX (cl.) Ἐλυμαίος, Ἔλαμος: Jdth.1:6; Ἀιλαμείτης (vv.ll. Ἐλ-, -αμίτης; Bl., § 3, 7): Isa.11:11 21:2 22:6) ;] an Elamite: Act.2:9.† (AS)

G1640.d: ἐλάσσων (-ττων, Heb_7:7, WH, 1Ti_5:9), -ον (formed, with superl. ἐλάχιστος, from the epic ἐλαχύς, little, and serving as compar. of μικρός), [in LXX for מָעַט, etc. ;] less, in age, rank or quality: Jhn.2:19, Rom.9:12" (LXX), Heb.7:7; neut., -ον, adverbially: 1Ti.5:9.† (AS)
G1640.ks: 나이, 지위, 질에서 더 작거나 덜하다는 뜻의 비교급 형용사. 요한복음 2장 19절 등에 나온다.

G1641.d: ἐλαττονέω, -ῶ (ἔλαττον), [in LXX (with -όω) chiefly for חָסֵר ;] to be less (RV, had no lack): 2Co.8:15 (LXX) (a rare word; cf. MM, Exp., xii).† (AS)
G1641.ks: 부족하다, 곧 더 적다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 고린도후서 8장 15절(칠십인역 인용)에 나온다.

G1642.d: ἐλαττόω, -ῶ (ἐλάιττων), [in LXX (where also -σσῶ) chiefly for חָסֵר, and very frequently in Sir ;] to make less: Heb.2:7 (LXX); pass., Jhn.3:30, Heb.2:9.† (AS)
G1642.ks: 줄이거나 낮게 하다라는 뜻의 동사. 히브리서 2장 7절과 9절, 요한복음 3장 30절에 나온다.

G1643.d: ἐλαύνω [in LXX: Isa.41:7 (הָלַם) Isa.33:21 (שַׁיִט), etc. ;] to drive: of the wind, Jas.3:4, 2Pe.2:17; of sailors rowing or sailing a boat, Mrk.6:48, Jhn.6:19; of demons, Luk.8:29 (cf. ἀπ-, συν-ελαύνω).† (AS)
G1643.ks: 바람이 몰아붙이거나 노를 저어 나아가다라는 뜻의 동사. 야고보서 3장 4절과 마가복음 6장 48절 등에 나온다.

G1644.ks: 가벼움이나 경솔함을 뜻하는 명사. 신약에서 나온다.

G1645.d: ἐλαφρός, -ά, -όν [in LXX chiefly for קַל, קָלָל ;] light in weight easy to bear: Mat.11:30; θλίψρις (EV, our light affliction), 2Co.4:17.† (AS)
G1645.ks: 무게가 가볍거나 지기 쉽다는 뜻의 형용사. 마태복음 11장 30절과 고린도후서 4장 17절에 나온다.

G1646.d: ἐλάχιστος, -η, -ον (see: ἐλάσσων), smallest, least: as proper superlat., 1Co.15:9; elsewhere, as usually in late Gk., intensive (B1., § 11, 3); Mat.2:6 (LXX) Mat.25:40, 45 Luk.12:26 16:10 19:17, 1Co.4:3 6:2, Jas.3:4; ἐ. ἐν τ. βασιλείᾳ τ. οὐρανῶν, Mat.5:19 (see Dalman, Words, 113). Compar., ἐλαχιστότερος (for corresp. superl., see LS; see also Bl., § 44, 3); less than the least: Eph.3:8.† (AS)
G1646.ks: 가장 작은 것을 뜻하는 최상급 형용사. 마태복음 5장 19절과 25장 40절, 고린도전서 15장 9절 등에 나온다.

G1649.ks: 꾸짖음, 책망을 뜻한다. 신약에서 베드로후서 2장 16절에만 나온다.

G1650.d: ἔλεγχος, -ου, ὁ (ἐλέγχω) [in LXX: frequently in Pr, Jb (יָכַח) יָכַח) Wis.5:1-23, Sir.3:1-31, etc. ;] a proof, test: Heb.11:1.† (AS)
G1650.ks: 증명이나 시험을 뜻한다. 신약에서 히브리서 11장 1절에만 나온다.

G1651.d: ἐλέγχω [in LXX chiefly for יָכַח hi. ;] 1. in Hom., to treat with contempt. 2. to convict: with accusative, Mat.18:15 (RV, show him his fault), Tit.1:9; before περί, Jhn.8:46 16:8, Ju 15; pass., Jas.2:9. 3. to reprove, re­buke: 1Ti.5:20, 2Ti.4:2, Tit.1:13 2:15, Rev.3:19; pass., before περί, Luk.3:19; ὑπό, Heb.12:5 (LXX). 4. to expose: Eph.5:11; pass., Jhn.3:20, 1Co.14:24 (RV reprove, mg. convict), Eph.5:13 (RV, as 1 Co, l.with, of. AR on Eph.5:11; MM, Exp., xii; cf. ἐξ-, δια-κατ-ελέγχομαι).† SYN.: ἐπιτιμῶ, expressing simply rebuke, which may be un­deserved (Mat.16:22) or ineffectual (Luk.23:40), while ἐλ. implies rebuke which brings conviction (see Tr., Syn., § iv) (AS)
G1651.ks: 잘못을 깨닫게 하거나 꾸짖다라는 뜻의 동사. 죄를 드러내 밝히는 일에도 쓰인다.

G1652.d: ἐλεεινός, -ή, -όν (ἔλεος in Re, l.with, WH have the Attic poëtic form, ἐλεινός), pitiable, miserable: Rev.3:17; comparat., 1Co.15:19.† (AS)
G1652.ks: 가련하고 비참하다는 뜻의 형용사. 요한계시록 3장 17절과 고린도전서 15장 19절에 나온다.

G1653.d: ἐλεέω (in Rom.9:16, Ju 22, -άω, which see), -ῶ (ἔλεος), [in LXX (Hex, Pss, Pr) chiefly for חָנַן, also frequently in Proph. for רָחַם, etc. ;] to have pity or mercy on, to show mercy: absol., Rom.9:16 12:8; with accusative, Mat.9:27 15:22 17:15 18:33 20:30-31, Mrk.5:19 10:47-48, Luk.16:24 17:13 18:38-39 Rom.9:15, 18 11:32, Php.2:27, Ju 22. Pass., to have pity or mercy shown one (EV, obtain mercy): Mat.5:7, Rom.11:30-31, 1Co.7:25, 2Co.4:1, 1Ti.1:13 1:16, 1Pe.2:10.† (AS)
G1653.ks: 불쌍히 여기고 자비를 베풀다라는 뜻의 동사. 복음서에서 도움을 구하는 사람들의 외침에 자주 나온다.

G1654.d: ἐλεημοσύνη, -ης, ἡ (ἐλεέω), [in LXX chiefly for חֶסֶד, צְדָקָה ;] 1. mercy, pity. 2. almsgiving, alms (like the German Almosen, a corruption of the Greek word ἐ): Mat.6:4; ποιεῖν ἐ., Mat.6:2-3, Act.9:36 10:2 24:17; ἐ. διδόναι, Luk.11:41 (cf. Mat.23:36; Dalman, Words, 62 f.) 12:33; αἰτεῖν, Act.3:2; λαβεῖν, Act.3:3; πρὸς (in order to ask) ἐ., Act.3:10; pl., Act.10:4, 31 (Cremer, 711).† (AS)
G1654.ks: 긍휼, 또는 가난한 이를 돕는 구제를 뜻한다. 마태복음 6장과 사도행전 등에 나온다.

G1655.d: ἐλεήμων, -ον [in LXX chiefly for חַנּוּן ;] merciful: Mat.5:7, Heb.2:17.† (AS)
G1655.ks: 자비롭다는 뜻의 형용사. 마태복음 5장 7절과 히브리서 2장 17절에 나온다.

G1656.d: ἔλεος, -ους, τό (cl. -ου, ὁ, and so Rec., Mat.9:13 12:7 23:23, Tit.3:5, Heb.4:16; on the Hellenistic form τό ἔ., see WH, App., 158; M, Pr., 60; Mayser, 277; Kühner, i, 515), [in LXX chiefly for חֶסֶד ;] mercy, pity, compassion; 1. of men: Mat.9:13 (LXX) Mat.12:7 23:23; ποιεῖν ἔ. (and id. before μετά, with genitive; cf. Heb. עִם חֶסֶד עָשָׂה, Gen.21:23, al.), Luk.10:37, Jas.2:13 3:17. 2. Of God: Luk.1:50, 54 1:58, Rom.15:9, Eph.2:4, 2Ti.1:16 1:18, Tit.3:5, Heb.4:16, 1Pe.1:3; esp. in benedictions, Gal.6:16, 1Ti.1:2, 2Ti.1:2, 2Jn.3, Ju 2; σκευὴ ἐλέους, Rom.9:23; σπλάγχνα ἐλέους, Luk.1:78; ποιεῖν ἔ. (see supr.), Luk.1:72; τ. ὑμετέρῳ ἐλέει, Rom.11:31. 3. Of Christ: Ju 21.† SYN.: οἰκτιρμός (see: ἐλεέω) (AS)
G1656.ks: 불쌍히 여기는 마음, 곧 자비를 뜻한다. 칠십인역에서 주로 히브리어 חֶסֶד(헤세드)에 해당한다.

G1657.d: ἐλευθερία, -ας, ἡ [in LXX: Lev.19:20 (חֻפְשָׁה), 1Es.4:49 Est.4:53, Sir.7:21, Sir.33:25, 1Ma.14:27, 3Ma.3:28 * ;] liberty: with reference to the religious life, 1Co.10:29, 2Co.3:17, Gal.2:4 5:1, 1Pe.2:16, 2Pe.2:19; ὁ νόμος τῆς ἐ., Jas.1:25 2:12; ἡ ἐ. τῆς δόξης, Rom.8:21; ἐπ᾽ ἐ., Gal.5:13 (on which formula, cf. Deiss., LAE, 327 ff.; Cremer, 251).† (AS)
G1657.ks: 자유를 뜻한다. 종교 생활에서의 자유를 말할 때 쓰이며 고린도후서 3장 17절, 갈라디아서 5장 1절 등에 나온다.

G1658.d: ἐλεύθερος, -α, -ον [in LXX chiefly for חׇפְשִׁי ;] free; (a) in civil sense, not a slave: Jhn.8:33, 1Co.7:21-22 12:13, Gal.3:28, Eph.6:8, Col.3:11, Rev.6:15 13:16 19:18; fem., Gal.4:22-23, 30; (b) as regards restraint and obligation in general: Mat.17:26, 1Co.9:1; before ἐκ, 1Co.9:19; ἀπό, Rom.7:3; with inf., 1Co.7:39; from the law, Gal.4:26, 1Pe.2:16; from sin, Jhn.8:32, 36; τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ, as regards righteousness, Rom.6:20 (Cremer, 249).† (AS)
G1658.ks: 종이 아닌 자유인, 또는 속박이나 의무에서 자유롭다는 뜻의 형용사.

G1659.d: ἐλευθερόω, -ῶ [in LXX: Pro.25:10. 2Ma.1:27 2Mac 2:22 * ;] to make free from sin, Jhn.8:32, 36; before ἀπό, Rom.6:18, 22 8:2, 21; τ. ἐλευθερία (dative commodi), Gal.5:1 (on the "punctiliar" force of this verb, see M, Pr. 149; cf. also Cremer, 251).† (AS)
G1659.ks: 죄나 율법에서 해방시키다라는 뜻의 동사. 요한복음 8장 32절과 36절, 로마서 6장 18절, 8장 2절에 나온다.

G1660.d: a coming:—;the Advent of our LORD, (New Testament) (ML)
G1660.ks: 오는 것, 곧 주님의 강림을 뜻하는 명사.

G1661.d: ἐλεφάντινος, -η, -ον (ἐλέφας, ivory), [in LXX for שֵׁן ;] of ivory: Rev.18:12.† (AS)
G1661.ks: 상아로 만들었다는 뜻의 형용사. 신약에서 요한계시록 18장 12절에만 나온다.

G1662G.d: Ἐλιακείμ(Heb. אֶלְיָקִים), Eliakim, an ancestor of Jesus: Mat.1:13, Luk.3:30.† (AS)

G1662H.d: Ἐλιακείμ(Heb. אֶלְיָקִים), Eliakim, an ancestor of Jesus: Mat.1:13, Luk.3:30.† (AS)

G1663.d: Ἐλιέζερ(Heb. אֱלִיעֶזֶר), ὁ, indecl., Eliezer, an ancestor of Jesus: Luk.3:29.† (AS)

G1664.d: Ἐλιούδ, ὁ indecl., Eliud, an ancestor of Jesus: Mat.1:14-15.† (AS)

G1665.d: Ἐλεισάβετ (T, Rec. Ἐλισ-; see WH, App., 155), ἡ indecl. (Heb. אֱלִישֶׁבַע) Elizabeth: Luk.1:5 ff.† (AS)

G1666.d: Ἐλισαῖος (Rec. Ἐλισσαῖος; Τ, Ἑλισ-), -ου, ὁ (Heb. אֱלִישָׁע), Elisha, the prophet: Luk.4:27.† (AS)

G1667.d: ἑλίσσω [in LXX: Isa.34:4 (גָּלַל ni.), Psa.102:26 (חָלַף hi.), etc. ;] to roll, roll up: Heb.1:12 (LXX), Rev.6:14.† (AS)
G1667.ks: 둘둘 말다라는 뜻의 동사. 히브리서 1장 12절과 요한계시록 6장 14절에 나온다.

G1668.d: ἑλκος, -εος (-ους), τό [in LXX: Exo.9:9-11, Lev.13:18-27, 4Ki.20:7, Job.2:7 (שְׁחִין) ;] 1. a wound (Hom.). 2. a sore, an ulcer (Thuc., al.): Luk.16:21, Rev.16:2, 11.† (AS)
G1668.ks: 상처나 궤양을 뜻한다. 누가복음 16장 21절과 요한계시록 16장 2절, 11절에 나온다.

G1669.d: ἑλκόω, -ῶ 1. to wound. 2. to ulcerate; pass., to suffer from sores: pf. ptcp., εἱλκωμίνος (Rec. ἡλκ-), EV, full of sores, Luk.16:20.† (AS)
G1669.ks: 종기로 덮이다라는 뜻의 동사. 누가복음 16장 20절에서 나사로의 상태를 가리킨다.

G1670.d: ἕλκω (Hellenistic form ἑλκύω in Jhn.11:1-57. with, Act.16:19), [in LXX for מָשַׁךְ, etc. ;] to draw: with accusative of thing(s), Jhn.18:10 21:6; with accusative of person(s), before ἔξω, Act.21:30; εἰς, Act.16:19, Jas.2:6. Metaphorical, to draw, lead, impel: Jhn.6:44 12:32. (For discussion of ἕ. in Oxyrh. Log., see Deiss., LAE, 437 ff.)† (AS)
G1670.ks: 끌어당기다라는 뜻의 동사. 물건이나 사람을 끌거나, 비유적으로 사람을 이끌 때 쓰인다.

G1671.d: Ἑλλάς, -άδος, ἡ [in LXX: Isa.66:19, Eze.27:13 (יָוָן), 1Ma.1:1 1Mac 8:9 * ;] with varying usage as to geographical limits; in NT = 'Αχαία (cf. Act.18:12), Greece: Act.20:2.† (AS)

G1672.d: Ἕλλην, -ηνος, ὁ [in LXX: Jol.3:6, Zec.9:13 (יָוָן), etc.; 1Ma.1:19, al. * ;] a Greek; opposite to βάρβαρος, Rom.1:14; usually in ΝΤ of Greek Gentiles, opposite to Ἰουδαῖοι: Jhn.7:35, Act.11:29 14:1 16:1, 3 18:4 19:19, 17 20:21 21:28 Rom.1:16 2:9-10 3:9 10:12, 1Co.1:22 1:24 10:32 12:13, Gal.2:3 3:28, Col.3:11; of proselytes, Jhn.12:29, Act.17:4.† (AS)

G1673.d: Ἑλληνικκός, -ή, -όν [in LXX: Jer.46:6 50:16 (יָנָה: aliter in Heb.), 2Ma.4:10 2Mac 4:15 2Mac 6:9 2Mac 11:24 2Mac 13:2, 4Ma.8:8 * ;] Greek: τ. Ἑλληνικῇ (sc. γλωσσῇ), Rev.9:11.† (AS)

G1674.d: Ἑλληνίς [in LXX: 2Ma.6:8 A * ;] a Greek (i.e. Gentile) woman: Mrk.7:26, Act.17:12.† (AS)

G1675.d: Ἑλληνιστής, -οῦ, ὁ (Ἑλληνίζω, to Hellenize, affect Greek cus­toms), a Hellenist (RV, Grecian Jew): Act.6:1 9:29 11:20.† (AS)

G1676.d: Ἑλληνιστί adv., in Greek: Jhn.19:20; Ἑ. (sc. λαλεῖν) γινώσκεις, Act.21:37 (cf. Field, Notes, 135).† (AS)
G1676.ks: 헬라어로라는 뜻의 부사. 요한복음 19장 20절과 사도행전 21장 37절에 나온다.

G1677.d: ἐλλογάω, -ῶ (a κοινή word, elsewhere usually -έω; cf. Bl., § 22, 2), to charge to one's account, impute: Phm 18 (on parallels, cf. Deiss., LAE, 79 f., 335 f.; Milligan, NTD, 73; MM, Exp., xii); of sin, Rom.5:13 (Cremer, 400).† (AS)
G1677.ks: 남의 계정에 올려놓다, 곧 전가하다라는 뜻의 동사. 빌레몬서 18절과 로마서 5장 13절에 나온다.

G1678.d: Ἐλμαδάμ (L, Ἑλ-; Rec. -μωδάμ), ό, indecl., Elmadam, an ancestor of Jesus: Luk.3:28. (AS)

G1679.d: ἐλπίζω [in LXX chiefly for בָּטַח, also for חָסָה, יָחַל pi., hi., etc. ;] to look for, expect, hope (for): with accusative of thing(s), Rom.8:24-25, 1Co.13:7, Heb.11:1; with dative of thing(s) (τ. τύχῃ, Thuc., iii, 97, 2), Mat.12:21; before καθώς, 2Co.8:5; with inf., Luk.6:34 23:8, Act.26:7, Rom.15:24, 1Co.16:7, 2Co.5:11, Php.2:19, 23, 1Ti.3:14, II Jn 12, 3Jn.14; before ὅτι, with pres., Luk.24:21; with fut., Act.24:26, 2Co.1:13 13:6, Phm 22. As in LXX (WM, § xxxiii, d; and esp. in the pf., Ellic. on 1Ti.4:10; Bl., § 59, 2), with prep.; εἰς, Jhn.5:45 (see Ellis., l.with), 1Pe.3:5; before ὅτι, 2Co.1:10; ἐπί, with dative, Rom.15:12 (LXX 1Ti.4:10 6:17; ἐν, 1Co.15:19; with accusative, 1Pe.1:13 (aor. imper. see Bl., § 58, 2); τ. θεόν, 1Ti.5:5 (of. ἀπ-, προ-ελπίζω, see Cremer, 255).† (AS)
G1679.ks: 기대하고 바라다라는 뜻의 동사. 로마서 8장 24절, 고린도전서 13장 7절, 히브리서 11장 1절 등에 나온다.

G1680.d: ἐλπίς (ἑλ-, Rom.8:20, WH, see Bl., § 4, 3; M, Pr., 44), -ίδος, ἡ [in LXX for בָּטַח and its derivatives, תִּקְוָה (frequently in Jb), etc. ;] expectation (in cl., rarely of evil, mostly of good, and so always in NT), hope; 1. of hope in general: 2Co.1:6; with genitive obj., Act.16:19; art. inf., Act.27:20, 1Co.9:10; παρ᾽ ἐλπίδα, Rom.4:18; ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι, 1Co.9:10. 2. Of religious hope: ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι, Act.2:26 26:6, Rom.4:18 8:20, Tit.1:2; τῇ ἐ. ἐσώθημεν, Rom.8:24; κατ᾽ ἐλπίδα ζωῆς αἰωνίου, Tit.3:7; of the Messianic hope of Israel, Act.23:6 26:6-7 28:20; of Christian hope, Rom.5:2-5 12:12 15:4, 13, 1Co.13:13, 2Th.2:16, Heb.3:6 6:11 7:19 10:23, 1Pe.1:3 1:21 3:15; with genitive obj., Rom.5:2, Col.1:27, 1Th.1:3 5:8, Tit.1:2; with genitive of that on which the hope is based, Act.26:6, Eph.1:18 4:4, Col.1:23; ὁ θεὸς τῆς ἐ., Rom.15:13; ἔχειν ἐ. (= cl. ἐλπίζειν), Act.24:15, Rom.15:4, 2Co.3:12 10:15, Eph.2:12, 1Th.4:13; before ἐπί, with dative, 1Jn.3:3; εἰς, Act.24:15; ὅτι, Rom.8:20, Php.1:20-21. Meton., (a) of the author or ground of hope (cl.): 1Th.2:19, 1Ti.1:1; with genitive obj., Col.1:27; (b) of the thing hoped for: Gal.5:5, Col.1:5, Tit.2:13, Heb.6:18 (Cremer, 252, 712).† (AS)
G1680.ks: 기대와 소망을 뜻하며, 신약에서는 항상 좋은 일에 대한 소망을 가리킨다.

G1681.d: Ἐλύμας, -α, ὁ (Aram. or Arab., cf. DB, i, 246 b) Elymas: Act.13:8.† (AS)

G1682.d: ἐλωί (-ΐ Rec.; ἑλωΐ LT; Aram. אֱלָהּ), Eloi: Mat.27:46, Mrk.15:34" (LXX) .† (AS)
G1682.ks: 아람어로 '나의 하나님'이라는 뜻이다. 마태복음 27장 46절과 마가복음 15장 34절에 나온다.

G1684.d: ἐμ-βαίνω [in LXX for עָלָה, etc. ;] to step into: Jhn.5:4 (WH, RV omit); εἰς πλοῖον, to embark: Mat.8:23 9:1 13:2 14:22 15:39, Mrk.4:1 5:18 6:45 8:10, 13, Luk.5:3 8:22, 37, Jhn.6:17, 24 21:3, Act.21:6.† (AS)
G1684.ks: 안으로 들어서다, 특히 배에 타다라는 뜻의 동사. 복음서와 사도행전에 자주 나온다.

G1685.d: ἐμ-βάλλω [in LXX for שׂוּם, etc. ;] to cast into: before εἰς, Luk.12:5 (cf. MM, Exp., vii, 93).† (AS)
G1685.ks: 안으로 던져 넣다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 누가복음 12장 5절에 나온다.

G1686.d: ἐμ-βάπτω to dip in: τ. χεῖρα ἐν τ. τρυβλίῳ, Mat.26:23; mid., before εἰς, Mrk.14:20.† (AS)
G1686.ks: 안에 담그다라는 뜻의 동사. 마태복음 26장 23절과 마가복음 14장 20절에 나온다.

G1687.d: ἐμβατεύω [in LXX: with accusative, Jos.19:49 (נָחַל, Jos.19:51 (חָלַק pi.); before εἰς, 1Ma.12:25 1Mac 13:20 1Mac 14:31 1Mac 15:40; metaphorically, 2Ma.2:30 * ;] (ἐμβάτης ἐμβαίνω) 1. to step in or on (Soph.), hence (a) to frequent, haunt, dwell in (Æsch., Eur.); metaphorically, Col.2:18 (dwelling in, R, txt.; taking, R, mg.); (b) to invade (1Mac, ll with; metaphorically, Col, Lc.). 2. to enter on, come into possession of (Eur., Dem.; LXX, Jos, H. with); on the difficulties of reading and interpretation in this passage, see Lft, Col., 194 f., 252; ICC, 268 ff.; Field, Notes, 197; Milligan, NTD, 177; and for exx. from π., MM, Exp., xii (cf. κενεμβ.).† (AS)
G1687.ks: 들어가 거하거나 살피다라는 뜻의 동사. 골로새서 2장 18절에 나온다.

G1688.d: ἐμ-βιβάζω [in LXX: 4Ki.9:23 (רָכַב hi.), Pro.4:11 (דָּרַךְ hi.) * ;] 1. to set in, put in. 2. to put on board ship, embark: with accusative of person(s), before εἰς, Act.27:6.† (AS)
G1688.ks: 배에 태우다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 사도행전 27장 6절에만 나온다.

G1689.d: ἐμ-βλέπω [in LXX for רָאָה, 3Ki.8:8, al.), פָּנָה (Job.6:28 A, al.); metaphorically, Isa.51:1 (נָבַט hi.), Sir.2:10, etc. ;] to look at: with accusative of thing(s), Mrk.8:25; with dative of person(s) (part., before λέγει, εἶπεν, cf. Xen., Cyr., i, 3, 2), Mat.19:26, Mrk.10:21, 27 14:67, Luk.20:17 22:61 (ἐνέβλεψεν), Jhn.1:36, 43; absol., to look, Act.22:11; metaphorically, to consider: Mat.6:26.† (AS)
G1689.ks: 자세히 바라보다라는 뜻의 동사. 사람을 보시거나 눈을 들어 바라볼 때 쓰인다.

G1690.d: ἐμ-βριμάομαι (T, -έομαι; Bl., § 22, 1), -ῶμαι (βρίμη, strength, bulk, whence βριμάομαι, to snort with anger), depon., with aor. mid. and pass., [in LXX (Hatch, Essays, 25): Dan LXX 11:30 (also Aq., Psa.7:12; Sm., Isa.17:13) * ;] to snort in (of horses, Æsch.), hence, to speak or act with deep feeling (DCG, i, 62b); (a) to be moved with anger (cf. ἐμβρίμημα, La 2:6): with dative, Mrk.14:5, Jhn.11:33; ἐν ἑαυτῷ, Jhn.11:38; (b) to admonish sternly: with dative, Mat.9:30, Mrk.1:43.† (AS)
G1690.ks: 깊은 감정으로 말하거나 행동하다라는 뜻의 동사. 분노나 격한 마음을 나타낸다.

G1692.ks: 토하다라는 뜻의 동사. 요한계시록 3장 16절에서 비유로 쓰인다.

G1693.d: ἐμ-μαίνομαι depon., to rage against: with dative, Act.26:11.† (AS)
G1693.ks: ~에게 미친 듯이 화를 내다라는 뜻의 동사. 신약에서 사도행전 26장 11절에 나온다.

G1695.d: Ἐμμαούς, ἡ Emmaus, a place 60 furlongs from Jerusalem: Luk.24:13.† (AS)

G1696.d: ἐμμένω [in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;] 1. to abide in: Act.28:30. 2. to abide by, be true to: before ἐν; τ. πίστει, Act.14:22; τ. διαθήκῃ, Heb.8:9 (LXX); with dative, τ. γεγραμμένοις (dative ptcp. as in legal formula; cf. Deiss., BS, 248; MM, Exp., xii): Gal.3:10 (LXX).† (AS)
G1696.ks: 안에 머무르다, 또는 지켜 신실하다라는 뜻의 동사. 사도행전 14장 22절과 히브리서 8장 9절에 나온다.

G1697.d: Ἑμμώρ (T, Ἐμμώρ, Rec. -όρ indecl. (Heb. חֲמוֹר), Emmor (Gen.33:19): Act.7:16.† (AS)

G1701.d: ἐμ-παιγμός, -οῦ, ὁ (ἐμπαίζω, which see), [in LXX: Eze.22:4 (קַלָּסָה), Ps 38:7 B א1 קָלָה ni.), Wis.12:2, Sir.27:28, 2Ma.7:7, 3Ma.5:22 * ;] a mocking: Heb.11:36.† (AS)

G1702.d: ἐμ-παίζω [in LXX for עָלַל hithp., שָׂחַק, etc. ;] = Attic προσ-, καταπαίζω, to mock at, mock (Hdt.): with dative, Mat.27:29, 31, Mrk.15:20, Luk.14:29 22:63 23:36; pass., Mat.2:16, Luk.18:32; absol., Mat.20:19 27:41, Mrk.10:34 15:31, Luk.23:11.† (AS)
G1702.ks: 비웃고 조롱하다라는 뜻의 동사. 예수님을 조롱한 장면(마 27장, 막 15장, 눅 23장)에 나온다.

G1703.d: ἐμ-παίκτης, -ου, ὁ (ἐμπαίζω, which see), [in LXX: Isa.3:4 (תַּעֲלוּל) * ;] a mocker: 2Pe.3:3, Ju 18.† (AS)
G1703.ks: 비웃는 사람을 뜻한다. 베드로후서 3장 3절과 유다서 18절에 나온다.

G1704.d: ἐν-περι-πατέω, -ῶ (Rec. ἐμπ-, see: ἐν) [in LXX: Lev.26:12 Job.1:7, al. (הָלַךְ hithp.), Wis.19:21 ;] to walk about in or among: before ἐν., dative of person(s), 2Co.6:16 (LXX),† (AS)
G1704.ks: ~안에서, ~가운데서 걸어 다니다라는 뜻의 동사. 고린도후서 6장 16절(칠십인역 인용)에 나온다.

G1705.d: ἐμ-πίπλημι (on ἐμπίμπ-, see LS, see word, Bl., § 6, 8), and ἐμπιπλάω (Act.14:17), [in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, שָׂבַע ;] to fill full, fill up, satisfy: with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), Luk.1:53, Act.14:17; pass., Luk.6:25, Jhn.6:12; metaphorically, with genitive of person(s), to take one's fill of: Rom.15:24 (cf. Dan LXX Su 32).† (AS)
G1705.ks: 가득 채우고 만족시키다라는 뜻의 동사. 누가복음 1장 53절과 사도행전 14장 17절에 나온다.

G1706.d: ἐμ-πίπτω [in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;] to fall into: before εἰς, Mat.12:11, Luk.6:39 10:36; metaphorically, εἰς κρίμα, 1Ti.3:6; ὀνειδισμόν 1Ti.3:7; πειρασμόν, 1Ti.6:9; εἰς χεῖρας θεοῦ (cf. 2Ki.24:14, 1Ch.21:13, Sir.2:18), Heb.10:31.† (AS)
G1706.ks: 안으로 떨어지다라는 뜻의 동사. 구덩이에 빠지거나 비유로 시험이나 비방에 빠질 때 쓰인다.

G1707.d: ἐμ-πλέκω [in LXX: Pro.28:18 (נָפַל), 2Ma.15:17 * ;] to weave in, entwine; pass., metaphorically, to be involved, entangled in: 2Ti.2:4, 2Pe.2:20.† (AS)
G1707.ks: 엮어 넣다, 곧 어떤 일에 얽매이다라는 뜻의 동사. 디모데후서 2장 4절과 베드로후서 2장 20절에 나온다.

G1708.ks: 머리카락을 땋는 것을 뜻한다. 신약에서 베드로전서 3장 3절에 나온다.

G1709.d: ἐν-πνέω, -ῶ (Rec. ἐμπ-, see: ἐν) [in LXX: Deu.20:16, Jos.10:28 ff. Jos.11:11, 14 (ptcp. neut., for נֶפֶשׁ, נְשָׁמָה), Wis.15:11 * ;] 1. to breathe on. 2. to breathe; (a) absol.; (b) with genitive part.: figuratively, ἀπειλῆς κ. φόνου, Act.9:1.† (AS)
G1709.ks: 숨을 내쉬다라는 뜻의 동사. 사도행전 9장 1절에서 위협과 살기를 내뿜는다고 비유로 쓰인다.

G1710.d: ἐμ-πορεύομαι depon. (ἔμπορος), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר ;] 1. to travel, esp. for business. 2. to traffc, trade: Jas.4:13. 3. C. accusative of thing(s) (a) to traffic in; (b) to import: (Hos.12:1, for יָבַל hoph.). 4. C. accusative of person(s), to make a gain of: 2Pe.2:3.† (AS)
G1710.ks: 여행하다, 또는 장사하다라는 뜻의 동사. 야고보서 4장 13절과 베드로후서 2장 3절에 나온다.

G1711.d: ἐμπορία, -ας, ἡ (ἔμπορος), [in LXX for סָחַר, רָכַל etc. ;] commerce, business, trade: Mat.22:5.† (AS)
G1711.ks: 상업, 거래를 뜻한다. 신약에서 마태복음 22장 5절에 나온다.

G1712.d: ἐμπόριον, -ον, τό (ἔμπορος) [in LXX: Deu.33:19 (סָפַן), Eze.27:3 (רָכַל); ἐ. εἶναι, Isa.23:17 (זָנָה)* ;] a trading place, exchange: οἶκος ἐμπορίου, Jhn.2:16.† (AS)
G1712.ks: 거래하는 장소를 뜻한다. 요한복음 2장 16절의 '장사하는 집'에 나온다.

G1713.d: ἔμ-πορος, -ου, ὁ (πόρος, a journey), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר, רָכַל ;] 1. a passenger on shipboard, one on a journey. 2. a merchant: Mat.13:45, Rev.18:3, 11 18:15, 23.† (AS)
G1713.ks: 배에 탄 여행자, 또는 장사꾼을 뜻한다. 마태복음 13장 45절과 요한계시록 18장에 나온다.
